title: Cost-Effectiveness of Annual Atrial Fibrillation Screening Compared with Current Opportunistic Screening in Australian Primary Care: A Model-Based Economic Evaluation.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Although the guidelines recommend opportunistic screening for adults ≥ 65 years, screening for atrial fibrillation (AF) remains underutilised in Australia. The absence of guidance on how often to screen has resulted in variable practice and missed opportunities for AF detection. Previous studies have focused on handheld devices rather than 12-lead electrocardiogram (ECG) devices that are readily available in primary-care settings, and the evidence supporting an annual AF screening programme in Australia is limited. Therefore, the aim of this study is to compare the cost-effectiveness of an annual, structured, higher‑coverage opportunistic ECG screening approach (annual screening) with current unstructured opportunistic screening (current screening) in older adults in Australia.

METHODS: A Markov model was developed to evaluate two strategies for adults ≥ 65 years: (1) annual screening using 12-lead ECG and (2) current opportunistic screening. The model included 11 health states capturing AF treatment and outcomes, and simulations were run using monthly cycles. A health system perspective and 10-year time horizon were applied. To account for uncertainty, a probabilistic sensitivity analysis with 1000 iterations was undertaken and the results were assessed against a cost-effectiveness threshold of 28,000 Australian dollars (AU$) per quality-adjusted life year (QALY). Uncertainty was further examined through cost-effectiveness acceptability curves and scenario analyses to test the stability of findings under alternative assumptions.

RESULTS: Annual screening increased costs by AU$4213 and gained 0.43 QALYs, yielding an incremental cost-effectiveness ratio of AU$9797 per QALY gained. Probabilistic sensitivity analysis demonstrated that 100% of simulations yielded a positive incremental net monetary benefit. Scenario analyses demonstrated that both higher screening costs and less frequent 3-yearly screening were cost-effective in comparison to the current opportunistic screening, with incremental cost-effectiveness ratios below the cost-effectiveness threshold and positive incremental net monetary benefits in all scenarios.

CONCLUSION: A structured annual screening approach for AF is likely to be a cost-effective strategy within the Australian primary-care setting. These findings highlight the benefits of more consistent screening practices for early AF detection and stroke prevention.

AI.tldr: 在澳大利亚≥65岁人群中，模型分析显示每年一次12导联心电图结构化房颤筛查较现行机会性筛查人均多花4213澳元、多获0.43个QALY，ICER为9797澳元/QALY，低于28000澳元阈值，具成本效果。

summary_zh:
背景：尽管指南建议对≥65岁的成年人进行机会性筛查，但在澳大利亚，心房颤动（AF）的筛查仍然利用不足。由于缺乏关于筛查频率的指导，导致临床实践存在差异，并错失了检出AF的机会。既往研究主要关注手持设备，而非在基层医疗环境中易于获得的12导联心电图（ECG）设备，且支持在澳大利亚开展年度AF筛查项目的证据有限。因此，本研究旨在比较澳大利亚老年人中年度、结构化、较高覆盖率的机会性ECG筛查策略（年度筛查）与当前非结构化的机会性筛查（当前筛查）的成本效果。

结果：年度筛查使成本增加AU$4213，并获得0.43个QALY，产生的增量成本效果比为每获得1个QALY需AU$9797。概率敏感性分析显示，100%的模拟均产生正的增量净货币效益。情景分析显示，与当前的机会性筛查相比，较高的筛查成本以及频率较低的每3年一次筛查均具有成本效果，所有情景下的增量成本效果比均低于成本效果阈值，且增量净货币效益均为正值。

结论：在澳大利亚基层医疗环境中，结构化的年度AF筛查策略很可能是一种具有成本效果的策略。这些发现凸显了更一致的筛查实践对于早期检出AF和预防卒中的益处。

title: Oral Obesity Medicines in the Era of Cardiovascular-Kidney-Metabolic Syndrome (CKM): Beyond Weight Loss Toward Disease Modification
summary: Obesity is a major driver of Cardiovascular-Kidney-Metabolic (CKM) syndrome and contributes to the development of atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease, heart failure, atrial fibrillation, chronic kidney disease, and type 2 diabetes. Historically, oral obesity pharmacotherapy was evaluated primarily according to weight loss efficacy. However, the emergence of the CKM framework has shifted therapeutic priorities toward modifying obesity related complications and improving long term clinical outcomes. This review summarizes currently approved oral obesity medications, including first generation agents (orlistat, phentermine/topiramate, and naltrexone/bupropion) and second generation incretin-based therapies (oral semaglutide and orforglipron), within the context of CKM syndrome. First generation agents provide modest-to-moderate weight loss and variable metabolic benefits, but evidence supporting cardiovascular or kidney outcome improvement remains limited and largely observational. In contrast, oral incretin-based therapies demonstrate broader effects across the CKM spectrum, including substantial weight reduction, improved glycemic control, favorable effects on blood pressure and triglycerides, and emerging kidney benefits. Among currently available oral agents, oral semaglutide has the strongest evidence, with the SOUL trial demonstrating a reduction in major adverse cardiovascular events in high-risk individuals with type 2 diabetes. Signals suggesting benefits in heart failure and atrial fibrillation are encouraging but remain exploratory. Orforglipron represents the first non-peptide oral glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist and offers simplified administration with promising metabolic efficacy; however, cardiovascular, kidney, heart failure, and arrhythmia outcome data are still awaited. Collectively, the role of oral obesity pharmacotherapy is evolving from weight management alone toward comprehensive CKM care.

title: ERRATUM: Beyond the classical triangle: morphological variations of the Triangle of Koch in human hearts and their clinical implications.
summary:
BACKGROUND: The Triangle of Koch (TOK) is an important anatomical region located in the right atrium of the heart. It contains the atrioventricular (AV) node and forms a crucial landmark during electrophysiological and cardiac surgical procedures. Variations in its boundaries and morphology may increase the risk of inadvertent injury to the cardiac conduction system. The present study aimed to evaluate the morphology (shape, boundaries, and anatomical variations) of the TOK in thirty donated human hearts and its clinical implications.

MATERIALS AND METHODS: Thirty formalin-fixed adult human hearts were studied in the Department of Anatomy. The right atrium was opened carefully to expose the TOK. The boundaries formed by the tendon of Todaro (TT), the septal leaflet of the tricuspid valve, and the ostium of the coronary sinus (CS) were identified. Morphological features, location of the apex, and anatomical variations were documented and photographed.

RESULTS: The TOK was identified in all specimens. Considerable variations were observed in shape, prominence of the TT, and position of the CS ostium. In most cases, it was broad and triangular, while in some hearts, the triangle appeared narrow and elongated. The apex corresponding to the AV nodal region showed positional variation relative to the membranous septum. Variability in the septal leaflet attachment and CS morphology was also noted.

CONCLUSIONS: The TOK demonstrates significant anatomical variation in its shape and boundaries. Knowledge of these variations is essential for cardiologists, electrophysiologists, and cardiac surgeons during catheter ablation, pacemaker implantation, and valve surgeries to prevent injury to the AV node and associated conduction pathways.

AI.tldr: 在30颗固定的人体心脏标本中，Koch三角的形状、Todaro腱突出程度与冠状窦口位置存在明显变异；多数呈宽大三角形，少数呈窄长形，且房室结区顶点相对膜部间隔的位置也有变化。
AI.motivation: Koch三角位于右心房，内含房室结，是电生理检查、导管消融与心脏外科手术的关键解剖标志；而其边界与形态一旦发生变异，就可能增加误伤房室结及传导系统的风险。既往文献多以"经典三角形"描述该区域，对形状、边界显著性及毗邻结构变异的系统性解剖学资料不足，本研究即针对这一缺口。
AI.method: 本研究为解剖学研究（期刊标注为勘误重发），在解剖学系对30颗经福尔马林固定的成人心脏标本进行观察：仔细切开右心房，暴露Koch三角；识别由Todaro腱、三尖瓣隔瓣与冠状窦口构成的边界；记录形态特征、顶点位置及解剖变异并拍照存档；摘要未报告定量测量方案与统计方法。
AI.result: 全部标本均可识别出Koch三角。形状、Todaro腱的突出程度和冠状窦口位置变异明显：多数标本三角宽大呈三角形，部分标本则窄而细长；对应房室结区的三角顶点相对膜部间隔的位置存在变动。三尖瓣隔瓣附着方式与冠状窦形态也有变异。摘要未报告各变异类型的例数比例、具体测量数值及P值。
AI.conclusion: Koch三角的形态与边界存在显著的解剖学变异。电生理医师与心外科医师在导管消融（尤其靠近房室结、慢径路区域）、起搏器植入及瓣膜手术中，应了解这些变异，以避免损伤房室结及相关传导通路。局限在于研究为小样本尸体解剖观察、缺乏定量统计与临床结局数据，结论尚需活体影像与电生理资料进一步验证。

summary_zh:
背景：Koch三角（TOK）是位于心脏右心房的重要解剖区域。其内包含房室（AV）结，并且在电生理和心脏外科手术过程中构成关键标志。其边界和形态的变异可能增加意外损伤心脏传导系统的风险。本研究旨在评估30例捐献的人心脏中TOK的形态（形状、边界和解剖变异）及其临床意义。

材料与方法：在解剖学系研究了30例经福尔马林固定的成人人类心脏。仔细切开右心房以显露TOK。识别由Todaro腱（TT）、三尖瓣隔瓣和冠状窦（CS）口所形成的边界。记录并拍摄形态学特征、顶端位置和解剖变异。

结果：所有标本中均识别出TOK。观察到形状、TT的显著程度和CS口位置存在相当大的变异。在大多数病例中，其宽大且呈三角形，而在一些心脏中，该三角显得狭窄且细长。对应于AV结区域的顶端相对于膜部室间隔显示出位置变异。还注意到隔瓣附着和CS形态的变异性。

结论：TOK在其形状和边界方面表现出显著的解剖变异。对于心脏病学家、电生理学家和心脏外科医生而言，在导管消融、起搏器植入和瓣膜手术过程中了解这些变异至关重要，以防止损伤AV结及相关传导通路。

title: Present state and future of screening for atrial fibrillation: a state-of-the-art review

Substrate Comprising Fibrosis and Epicardial Adipose Tissue-Associated Electrophysiological Remodeling Can Sustain Atrial Fibrillation Drivers: Insights from Image-Personalized Computational Simulations.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Computational models of atrial fibrillation (AF) help clarify arrhythmia mechanisms, but the contribution of left atrial (LA) epicardial adipose tissue (EAT) is rarely included.

OBJECTIVE: To assess whether incorporating EAT-associated effects into fibrosis-based atrial models alters reentrant arrhythmia inducibility, and to characterize the pro-arrhythmic properties of EAT-affected tissue.

METHODS: LA fibrosis and EAT were quantified by LGE and Dixon MRI in 19 patients with persistent AF. For each patient, three anatomically identical image-personalized models were built (fibrosis only; fibrosis plus half-epicardial EAT effects, 0.5 mm; fibrosis plus full-epicardial EAT effects, 1.0 mm), yielding 855 simulations. In EAT regions, inward rectifier K+ current was reduced by 35%, intracellular K+ by 50%, and conduction velocity by 25%.

RESULTS: Sustained reentry occurred in 370 simulations (43.3%), of which 306 had a functional (rotor-driven) component. Functional reentry inducibility rose from 22.8% (fibrosis only) to 41.4% (half-EAT) and 43.2% (full-EAT). At least one functional reentry was inducible in 12/19 fibrosis-only models, 18/19 half-EAT models, and 19/19 full-EAT models. Median inducible simulations per patient increased from 4 to 6 (p=0.004) and 7 (p=0.003), without significant difference between half- and full-EAT (p=0.895). Fibrosis/EAT overlap regions comprised only 2.1% of the LA wall but were the most arrhythmogenic, with a median 65.5% of their volume harboring reentry versus 8.8% (non-substrate), 37.3% (fibrosis), and 42.8% (EAT) (all p<0.001). In an exploratory analysis of PVI-only ablation patients (n=13), fibrosis-EAT overlap outside the PVI region was associated with 1-year recurrence (log-rank p=0.007).

CONCLUSION: Adding EAT effects to fibrosis-based models increased sustained functional reentry, with transmural depth contributing only modestly. Reentry anchored preferentially where fibrosis and EAT effects coexisted.

AI.tldr: 在19例持续性房颤患者的影像个体化计算模型中，叠加心外膜脂肪组织（EAT）电生理效应可使功能性折返可诱发性从22.8%升至43.2%，折返优先锚定于纤维化与EAT重叠区域。
AI.motivation: 计算建模是解析房颤机制的重要工具，但既往基于纤维化的左房模型几乎未纳入心外膜脂肪组织（EAT）的影响，EAT对折返可诱发性的独立贡献及其致心律失常基质特征尚不明确。本研究旨在检验在纤维化模型中加入EAT相关电生理改变是否会改变折返性心律失常的可诱发性，并刻画受EAT影响组织的致心律失常特性。
AI.method: 计算仿真研究。纳入19例持续性房颤患者，以LGE-MRI和Dixon MRI定量左房纤维化与EAT。为每例患者构建3个解剖结构一致的影像个体化模型：单纯纤维化、纤维化+半层心外膜EAT效应（0.5 mm）、纤维化+全层EAT效应（1.0 mm），共产生855次仿真。EAT区域内设定内向整流钾电流（IK1）降低35%、细胞内钾降低50%、传导速度降低25%。终点为持续性折返（含功能性/转子驱动成分）的可诱发性及折返在基质各区域的分布。统计比较采用患者层面可诱发仿真数的配对检验（摘要未报告具体检验方法及95%CI）。
AI.result: 855次仿真中370次（43.3%）出现持续性折返，其中306次含功能性（转子驱动）成分。功能性折返可诱发性由单纯纤维化模型的22.8%升至半层EAT的41.4%和全层EAT的43.2%；至少可诱发1次功能性折返的患者分别为12/19、18/19和19/19。每例患者可诱发仿真数中位数由4分别增至6（p=0.004）和7（p=0.003），半层与全层EAT之间无显著差异（p=0.895）。纤维化/EAT重叠区仅占左房壁面积的2.1%，但致心律失常性最强：该区域内中位65.5%的体积存在折返，而单纯非基质区为8.8%、单纯纤维化区为37.3%、单纯EAT区为42.8%（均p<0.001）。探索性分析中，13例仅行PVI的消融患者里，PVI区域以外的纤维化-EAT重叠与1年复发相关（log-rank p=0.007）。
AI.conclusion: 在纤维化基础上叠加EAT相关电生理重塑可显著提高持续性功能性折返的可诱发性，而EAT效应的透壁深度仅起有限作用；折返优先锚定于纤维化与EAT效应共存处，提示该重叠区是房颤驱动灶的关键基质。研究为以影像识别纤维化-EAT重叠区、并在PVI之外进行基质改良提供了机制假说，探索性临床结果支持其与消融后复发相关。局限性包括样本量小（19例建模、13例消融随访）、模型参数来源于文献假设而非个体实测、仅针对持续性房颤，结论尚需前瞻性验证。

summary_zh:
背景：心房颤动（AF）的计算模型有助于阐明心律失常机制，但左心房（LA）心外膜脂肪组织（EAT）的作用很少被纳入。

目的：评估将EAT相关效应纳入基于纤维化的心房模型是否会改变折返性心律失常的可诱发性，并描述受EAT影响组织的促心律失常特性。

方法：采用LGE和Dixon MRI对19例持续性AF患者的LA纤维化和EAT进行定量。为每位患者构建三个解剖结构完全相同的影像个体化模型（仅纤维化；纤维化加半层心外膜EAT效应，0.5 mm；纤维化加全层心外膜EAT效应，1.0 mm），共产生855次模拟。在EAT区域，内向整流钾电流降低35%，细胞内钾降低50%，传导速度降低25%。

结果：370次模拟（43.3%）出现持续性折返，其中306次具有功能性（转子驱动）成分。功能性折返的可诱发性从22.8%（仅纤维化）升至41.4%（半层EAT）和43.2%（全层EAT）。仅纤维化模型中有12/19可诱发至少一个功能性折返，半层EAT模型为18/19，全层EAT模型为19/19。每位患者可诱发模拟数的中位数从4增至6（p=0.004）和7（p=0.003），半层EAT与全层EAT之间无显著差异（p=0.895）。纤维化/EAT重叠区域仅占LA壁的2.1%，但致心律失常性最强，其体积中中位数65.5%存在折返，相比之下非基质区为8.8%、纤维化区为37.3%、EAT区为42.8%（均p<0.001）。在一项仅行PVI消融患者的探索性分析中（n=13），PVI区域以外的纤维化-EAT重叠与1年复发相关（log-rank p=0.007）。

结论：在基于纤维化的模型中加入EAT效应可增加持续性功能性折返，而透壁深度的影响仅为中等程度。折返优先锚定于纤维化与EAT效应共存的部位。

title: Conduction System Recovery After Pulsed Field Ablation of a Para-Hisian PVC.
Nuclear magnetic resonance-derived lipoprotein profile and risk of atrial tachyarrhythmia recurrence after catheter ablation: a case-cohort design within the PREDIMAR trial.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Lipoproteins could be potential biomarkers of atrial tachyarrhythmia recurrence (TAR) after catheter ablation; however, their association remains inconclusive and based exclusively on routine lipid measurements. Nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) enables detailed lipoprotein characterization beyond conventional assays.

OBJECTIVE: To identify a baseline NMR-derived lipoprotein profile associated with the risk of TAR after catheter ablation.

METHODS: We conducted a case-cohort study (212 cases and 238 participants in a random sub-cohort, with 93 overlapping cases) nested in the PREDIMAR (PRevención con DIeta Mediterránea de Arritmias Recurrentes) trial. Conventional lipoprotein profiles were measured using the Pentra C-200 and advanced lipoprotein profiles were assessed by NMR. Lipoprotein values were normalized and scaled to one standard deviation using Blom's inverse normal transformation. Cox models were used to assess the associations between baseline lipoproteins and TAR. Additionally, a cholesteryl ester transfer (CETP)-mediated lipoprotein exchange score was constructed and evaluated.

RESULTS: After 18-month follow-up, higher baseline remnant cholesterol (hazard ratio = 1.26, 95% confidence interval= 1.06-1.51, per SD), higher cholesterol and triglyceride content in very-low-density lipoproteins (VLDL) (hazard ratioperSD = 1.22, 95% confidence interval= 1.03-1.46) or in intermediate-density lipoproteins (IDL) (hazard ratioperSD = 1.29, 95% confidence interval= 1.09-1.52), showed increased risks of TAR. Higher triglyceride-to-HDL cholesterol ratio was directly associated, and higher triglyceride-to-VLDL cholesterol and triglyceride-to-IDL cholesterol ratios were inversely associated with recurrence. A CETP-mediated lipoprotein exchange score was directly associated with recurrence.

CONCLUSION: An atherogenic lipoprotein profile characterized by elevated remnant cholesterol is associated with a higher risk of TAR after catheter ablation.

AI.tldr: 在 PREDIMAR 试验内嵌的病例-队列分析中，基线 NMR 脂蛋白谱显示以残粒胆固醇升高为特征的致动脉粥样硬化表型，与导管消融后 18 个月内房性快速性心律失常复发风险升高独立相关。
AI.motivation: 脂蛋白有望成为预测导管消融后房性快速性心律失常复发（TAR）的生物标志物，但既有证据结论不一致，且几乎全部基于常规血脂检测；核磁共振（NMR）可对脂蛋白颗粒数量与成分进行更精细的刻画，其与消融后复发的关系尚不清楚，这是本研究要填补的缺口。
AI.method: 研究类型：PREDIMAR（地中海饮食预防心律失常复发）随机试验内嵌的病例-队列研究。研究对象为接受导管消融的房颤患者；样本量：212 例复发病例与 238 名随机亚队列成员，其中 93 例为重叠病例。暴露为基线常规血脂（Pentra C-200）与 NMR 精细脂蛋白谱，所有脂蛋白指标经 Blom 逆正态转换后按 1 个标准差（SD）标化。主要终点为随访 18 个月内的 TAR。统计方法为 Cox 模型估计每 SD 的风险比（HR），并构建并评估胆固醇酯转移蛋白（CETP）介导的脂蛋白交换评分。摘要未报告校正的混杂变量及随访完整度。
AI.result: 随访 18 个月后，基线残粒胆固醇每升高 1 SD，TAR 风险升高（HR=1.26，95%CI 1.06–1.51）；极低密度脂蛋白（VLDL）中胆固醇及甘油三酯含量升高（HR=1.22，95%CI 1.03–1.46）、中间密度脂蛋白（IDL）相应成分升高（HR=1.29，95%CI 1.09–1.52）均与复发风险升高相关。甘油三酯/HDL 胆固醇比值与复发呈正相关，而甘油三酯/VLDL 胆固醇比值与甘油三酯/IDL 胆固醇比值与复发呈负相关。CETP 介导的脂蛋白交换评分与复发呈正相关。摘要未报告各项分析的 P 值及该评分的具体效应量。
AI.conclusion: 以残粒胆固醇升高为核心的致动脉粥样硬化脂蛋白谱与导管消融后 TAR 风险增加相关，提示 NMR 脂蛋白检测可能用于术后复发风险分层，并指向 CETP 介导的脂质交换作为潜在机制通路。局限性包括：病例-队列观察性设计无法确立因果、摘要未报告 P 值与多变量校正模型、随访仅 18 个月且缺乏外部验证，因此尚不足以据此改变围消融期降脂或抗心律失常治疗决策。

summary_zh:
背景：脂蛋白可能是导管消融后房性快速性心律失常复发（TAR）的潜在生物标志物；然而，其相关性仍无定论，且既往研究仅基于常规血脂测量。核磁共振（NMR）能够实现超越传统检测的详细脂蛋白表征。

目的：识别与导管消融后 TAR 风险相关的基线 NMR 衍生脂蛋白谱。

方法：我们在 PREDIMAR（PRevención con DIeta Mediterránea de Arritmias Recurrentes）试验内嵌套开展了一项病例-队列研究（212 例病例和随机子队列中的 238 名参与者，其中 93 例为重叠病例）。采用 Pentra C-200 测量常规脂蛋白谱，并通过 NMR 评估高级脂蛋白谱。使用 Blom 逆正态变换对脂蛋白值进行归一化，并缩放至一个标准差。采用 Cox 模型评估基线脂蛋白与 TAR 之间的关联。此外，构建并评估了一个由胆固醇酯转移（CETP）介导的脂蛋白交换评分。

结果：随访 18 个月后，较高的基线残粒胆固醇（风险比 = 1.26，95% 置信区间 = 1.06-1.51，每标准差）、较高的极低密度脂蛋白（VLDL）中胆固醇和甘油三酯含量（每标准差风险比 = 1.22，95% 置信区间 = 1.03-1.46）或较高的中间密度脂蛋白（IDL）中胆固醇和甘油三酯含量（每标准差风险比 = 1.29，95% 置信区间 = 1.09-1.52），均显示 TAR 风险增加。较高的甘油三酯与 HDL 胆固醇比值与复发呈正相关，而较高的甘油三酯与 VLDL 胆固醇比值以及甘油三酯与 IDL 胆固醇比值与复发呈负相关。CETP 介导的脂蛋白交换评分与复发呈正相关。

结论：以残粒胆固醇升高为特征的致动脉粥样硬化性脂蛋白谱与导管消融后 TAR 风险较高相关。

title: Dynamics of P wave Morphological Variability Preceding the Onset of Atrial Fibrillation.
summary:
Although the problem of predicting atrial fibrillation (AF) has been extensively studied, the electrophysiological changes that precede AF onset remain insufficiently understood. From a clinical perspective, better understanding of such changes should facilitate future monitoring, prediction strategies, and therapeutic decisions.

OBJECTIVE: To investigate the temporal characteristics of P wave morphological variability (PMV) in a 60-min segment preceding the onset of atrial fibrillation (AF).

METHODS: Ambulatory ECG recordings from 32 patients comprising 176 AF episodes are analyzed. The P wave is emphasized by a linear, spatial transformation of the ECG. Using a novel, robust parameter, the PMV is computed in successive 2-min subsegments of a 60-min pre-AF segment. A piecewise linear model, accounting for basic PMV characteristics, is fitted to the resulting data points, followed by clustering of the model parameter estimates together with the supraventricular ectopic burden.

RESULTS: In 63% of the segments, an increase in PMV was found with a change point ranging from 4 to 17 min before AF onset. Clustering demonstrated heterogeneous characteristics manifested by two clusters associated with an increase in PMV, and two other clusters associated with a low and stable PMV of which one had a much larger ectopic burden.

CONCLUSIONS: Clustering suggests that an AF episode may be preceded by focal ectopic activity, conduction destabilization, or without any observed manifestation.

SIGNIFICANCE: The proposed framework provides a physiologically interpretable stratification of the pre-AF dynamics of the P wave morphology.

AI.tldr: 在32例患者176次房颤发作前60分钟的动态心电中，63%的片段显示P波形态变异度（PMV）于发作前4~17分钟出现升高拐点，聚类提示发作前存在异位灶活动、传导不稳定或无明显先兆三种模式。
AI.motivation: 房颤预测问题虽已被大量研究，但发作前即刻的电生理改变仍认识不足；厘清P波形态变异度在房颤发作前的时间演变规律，有助于优化监测策略、预测模型与治疗决策。
AI.method: 回顾性分析32例患者的动态心电记录，共176次房颤发作。通过线性空间变换突出P波，在房颤发作前60分钟片段内以连续2分钟子片段计算新的稳健PMV参数；对所得数据点拟合分段线性模型（纳入PMV基本特征），并将模型参数估计值与室上性异位搏动负荷一起进行聚类分析。摘要未报告终点的具体统计学检验方法。
AI.result: 63%的片段中PMV呈升高趋势，其变化拐点位于房颤发作前4~17分钟。聚类分析显示异质性特征：两个聚类表现为PMV升高，另两个聚类表现为PMV低且稳定，其中之一的异位搏动负荷明显更高。摘要未报告各聚类的具体例数、效应量、95%置信区间及P值。
AI.conclusion: 聚类结果提示房颤发作前可能存在三种情形：局灶性异位活动、传导稳定性下降，或缺乏可观察到的先兆表现。该框架为房颤发作前P波形态动力学提供了具生理可解释性的分层方式；但样本量较小（32例、176次发作）、仅基于动态心电的形态学参数，尚无前瞻性验证，距离指导临床监测与消融决策仍需进一步研究。

summary_zh:
尽管心房颤动（AF）的预测问题已被广泛研究，但AF发作前的心电生理改变仍未得到充分认识。从临床角度看，更好地理解这些改变应有助于未来改进监测、预测策略及治疗决策。

目的：探讨心房颤动（AF）发作前60分钟时段内P波形态变异性（PMV）的时间特征。

方法：分析32例患者共176次AF发作的动态心电图记录。通过心电图的线性空间变换突出P波。采用一种新颖且稳健的参数，在AF发作前60分钟时段的连续2分钟子段中计算PMV。对所得数据点拟合一个考虑PMV基本特征的分段线性模型，随后将模型参数估计值与室上性异位搏动负荷一起进行聚类。

结果：在63%的时段中，发现PMV升高，其变化点位于AF发作前4至17分钟。聚类显示出异质性特征，表现为两个与PMV升高相关的聚类，以及另外两个与低且稳定的PMV相关的聚类，其中之一的异位搏动负荷明显更大。

结论：聚类结果提示，AF发作之前可能存在局灶性异位活动、传导不稳定，或没有任何可观察到的表现。

意义：所提出的框架为AF发作前P波形态的动力学提供了具有生理学可解释性的分层。

title: Right Atrium-Dominant Single-Loop Biatrial Tachycardia Mimicking Reverse Typical Atrial Flutter After Mitral Valve Repair via a Superior Transseptal Approach.
summary: Following a superior transseptal approach, extensive postoperative septal conduction impairment facilitated a right atrium-dominant single-loop biatrial tachycardia mimicking reverse typical atrial flutter. Detailed biatrial mapping and entrainment revealed limited left atrial participation, highlighting the importance of recognizing biatrial circuits in patients with prior septal surgery.

AI.tldr: 一例经上房间隔入路行二尖瓣修复术后的患者，因房间隔传导广泛受损，形成以右房为主导、心电图模拟逆典型房扑的单环双房心动过速；双房标测与拖曳起搏证实左房参与有限。
AI.motivation: 经上房间隔入路行二尖瓣手术可造成房间隔传导障碍，术后房性心动过速的机制可能涉及双房大折返环，而不仅限于单房环路。此类双房环路在体表心电图上易被误判为逆典型房扑，如果仅按典型房扑思路消融，可能遗漏关键环路部位，导致手术失败或复发。摘要未报告既往该人群双房环路发生率的证据缺口细节。
AI.method: 个案报告（单例），摘要未报告样本量、纳入与排除标准、终点定义及统计方法。研究对象为二尖瓣修复术后（经上房间隔入路）发生房性心动过速的患者。干预或暴露为术后房间隔传导障碍。采用详细的双房三维电解剖标测与拖曳起搏（entrainment），判定心动过速的环路性质、主导心房及左房参与范围。
AI.result: 标测显示，术后房间隔存在广泛的传导障碍，并形成以右房为主导的单环双房心动过速，其心电图形态模拟逆典型房扑；拖曳起搏提示左房参与范围有限。摘要未报告心动过速周期长度、拖曳起搏的回复周期与心动过速周期差值（PPI-TCL）、激动标测时间及消融结果等具体数值。
AI.conclusion: 对于曾接受房间隔部位手术的患者，当出现类似逆典型房扑的房性心动过速时，应考虑到双房大折返环的可能，需进行完整的双房标测与拖曳起搏，以明确环路并指导消融策略。局限性为单例报告，摘要未提供量化电生理参数与随访数据，结论不能外推，尚需病例系列进一步验证。

summary_zh: 经上房间隔入路（superior transseptal approach）后，术后广泛的间隔传导障碍促成了以右心房为主的单环双房心动过速，其表现酷似反向典型心房扑动。详细的双房标测与拖带（entrainment）显示左心房参与有限，这凸显了在既往接受间隔手术的患者中识别双房折返环的重要性。

title: Sleep-Disordered Breathing and Sleep Fragmentation in Relation to Atrial Fibrillation Risk: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
summary: Background Atrial fibrillation (AF) is one of the most prevalent cardiac arrhythmias worldwide. This study aimed to evaluate the association between sleep-disordered breathing (SDB), primarily assessed using the apnea-hypopnea index (AHI), and AF risk, with additional analysis of sleep fragmentation parameters such as wake after sleep onset (WASO) and arousal index (AI).Methods This systematic review and meta-analysis followed Cochrane Handbook recommendations and PRISMA guidelines, with protocol registration in PROSPERO (No. 127490). Randomized controlled trials (RCTs) and observational cohort studies assessing sleep disturbances and AF were included. MEDLINE, Cochrane Library, and Scopus were searched from inception to February 2026. Extracted data included study characteristics, demographics, cardiovascular risk factors, and sleep metrics. Outcomes were incident and recurrent AF. A random-effects model was applied.Results Twenty-one cohort studies (611,898 participants) were included. SDB was associated with increased incident AF risk (RR 1.67, 95% CI 1.41-1.97; I 2 = 66.5%), with consistent Bayesian estimates. A dose-response relationship showed a 2% increase in AF risk per unit rise in AHI. For AF recurrence, 11 studies (n = 1810) demonstrated a significant association (RR 1.55, 95% CI 1.40-1.72; I 2 = 0%), supported by Bayesian analysis.Conclusion Sleep disturbances are significantly associated with both incident and recurrent AF and may represent modifiable risk factors.

AI.tldr: 21 项队列研究、61 万余人汇总显示，睡眠呼吸障碍使新发房颤风险升高 67%，房颤复发风险升高 55%，AHI 每升高 1 个单位房颤风险增加约 2%。
AI.motivation: 房颤是全球最常见的心律失常之一，睡眠呼吸障碍（SDB）作为潜在可干预因素一直受到关注，但既往研究多为小样本或单一终点，对 SDB 与新发房颤、房颤复发的效应量估计不一致，且睡眠碎片化指标（入睡后觉醒时间 WASO、微觉醒指数 AI）的证据更为零散，缺乏系统汇总。
AI.method: 系统综述与 meta 分析，遵循 Cochrane 手册与 PRISMA 规范，方案在 PROSPERO 注册（No. 127490）。检索 MEDLINE、Cochrane Library 与 Scopus（建库至 2026 年 2 月），纳入评估睡眠障碍与房颤关系的随机对照试验及观察性队列研究。提取研究特征、人口学资料、心血管危险因素与睡眠指标；主要暴露为以呼吸暂停低通气指数（AHI）评估的 SDB，并分析 WASO、AI 等睡眠碎片化参数；终点为新发房颤与房颤复发；采用随机效应模型，并辅以贝叶斯分析。
AI.result: 共纳入 21 项队列研究、611,898 名受试者。SDB 与新发房颤风险升高相关（RR 1.67，95%CI 1.41–1.97；I²=66.5%），贝叶斯估计结果一致；剂量-反应分析显示 AHI 每升高 1 个单位，房颤风险增加约 2%。房颤复发方面，11 项研究（n=1810）显示显著关联（RR 1.55，95%CI 1.40–1.72；I²=0%），贝叶斯分析支持该结果。WASO 与 AI 的具体效应量摘要未报告。
AI.conclusion: 睡眠障碍与新发房颤及房颤复发均显著相关，可能为可干预的危险因素。提示在房颤筛查与消融围术期管理中应重视睡眠呼吸监测与治疗；但纳入研究均为观察性设计，残余混杂无法排除，睡眠碎片化指标证据不足，尚需随机对照试验验证干预睡眠呼吸障碍能否降低房颤发生与复发。

summary_zh:
背景：心房颤动（AF）是全球最常见的心律失常之一。本研究旨在评估睡眠呼吸障碍（SDB）——主要采用呼吸暂停低通气指数（AHI）评估——与AF风险之间的关联，并进一步分析睡眠碎片化参数，如入睡后觉醒时间（WASO）和觉醒指数（AI）。

方法：本系统综述和荟萃分析遵循Cochrane手册建议和PRISMA指南，方案已在PROSPERO注册（编号127490）。纳入评估睡眠障碍与AF的随机对照试验（RCT）和观察性队列研究。检索MEDLINE、Cochrane Library和Scopus，检索时间从建库至2026年2月。提取的数据包括研究特征、人口学资料、心血管危险因素和睡眠指标。结局为AF的发生和复发。采用随机效应模型。

结果：共纳入21项队列研究（611,898名参与者）。SDB与AF发生风险增加相关（RR 1.67，95% CI 1.41-1.97；I² = 66.5%），贝叶斯估计结果一致。剂量-反应关系显示，AHI每升高1个单位，AF风险增加2%。对于AF复发，11项研究（n = 1810）显示存在显著关联（RR 1.55，95% CI 1.40-1.72；I² = 0%），并得到贝叶斯分析支持。

结论：睡眠障碍与AF的发生和复发均显著相关，且可能是可改变的危险因素。

title: Renal Sympathetic Denervation Plus Pulmonary Vein Isolation for Atrial Fibrillation in Patients with Hypertension: A Meta-Analysis of Randomised Controlled Trials.
summary: To assess the efficacy and safety of adding adjuvant renal sympathetic denervation (RSDN) to pulmonary vein isolation (PVI) in patients with atrial fibrillation (AF). A search of multiple electronic databases was conducted using a comprehensive strategy to identify randomised controlled trials (RCTs) evaluating the impact of RSDN combined with PVI compared with PVI alone in patients with AF and hypertension. The search results were imported to Covidence for article eligibility screening. Six RCTs were included, involving a total of 516 patients. The rate of AF recurrence [RR: 0.58, 95% CI (0.40; 0.82), p = 0.002, I2 = 28%] was significantly lower with RSDN+PVI compared to PVI alone at 12 months, whereas no significant difference was found at 24 months (p = 0.93). RSDN+PVI significantly reduced systolic blood pressure (SBP) at 12 months (MD: -13.41, 95% CI = -15.59; -11.22, p <0.001, I2 = 88%) and diastolic blood pressure (DBP) at 12 months (MD: -4.54, 95% CI -7.66; -1.42, p = 0.004, I2 = 81%) compared to PVI alone. This meta-analysis demonstrated that SBP and DBP, as well as AF recurrence, were lower at 12 months in the PVI plus adjunctive RSDN therapy group than in the PVI-alone group. Key Words: Renal sympathetic denervation, Pulmonary vein isolation, Atrial fibrillation, Hypertension, Catheter ablation, Antiarrhythmic therapy.

AI.tldr: 纳入6项RCT共516例房颤合并高血压患者的荟萃分析显示，PVI联合肾交感神经消融较单纯PVI在12个月时显著降低房颤复发率（RR 0.58）并降低血压，但24个月时复发无差异。
AI.motivation: 高血压是房颤发生与导管消融术后复发的重要驱动因素，肾交感神经过度激活被认为参与其中的心房电重构与结构重构过程。单纯肺静脉隔离（PVI）在合并高血压的房颤患者中复发率偏高，既往关于在PVI基础上附加肾交感神经消融（RSDN）的小样本研究结论不一致，缺乏对随机对照试验（RCT）的系统汇总证据，本研究即为此开展荟萃分析。
AI.method: 系统综述与荟萃分析。检索多个电子数据库，采用综合检索策略筛选比较RSDN+PVI与单纯PVI治疗的RCT，检索结果导入Covidence进行文献合格性筛选。最终纳入6项RCT、共516例房颤合并高血压患者。主要观察AF复发率（12个月及24个月），并汇总12个月收缩压（SBP）与舒张压（DBP）变化；效应量以复发风险比（RR）与均数差（MD）及95%置信区间表示，并报告I²评估异质性。
AI.result: 与单纯PVI相比，RSDN+PVI组12个月AF复发率显著降低（RR 0.58，95%CI 0.40–0.82，P=0.002，I²=28%）；但24个月时两组复发率无显著差异（P=0.93）。血压方面，RSDN+PVI组12个月SBP下降更明显（MD -13.41 mmHg，95%CI -15.59至-11.22，P<0.001，I²=88%），DBP亦显著降低（MD -4.54 mmHg，95%CI -7.66至-1.42，P=0.004，I²=81%）。围术期并发症等安全性终点摘要未报告。
AI.conclusion: 该荟萃分析提示，在合并高血压的房颤患者中，PVI联合RSDN可在12个月时降低房颤复发并进一步降低SBP与DBP，但其获益未能维持至24个月，且血压终点的异质性较高（I² 81%–88%），结果需谨慎解读。摘要未报告安全性结局与消融相关细节，RSDN作为PVI辅助手段的长期疗效与风险尚需更大样本、更长随访的RCT验证，目前不宜作为常规策略推广。

summary_zh: 评估在房颤（AF）患者中于肺静脉隔离（PVI）基础上加用辅助性肾交感神经去支配术（RSDN）的有效性和安全性。采用全面检索策略对多个电子数据库进行检索，以识别评估在合并高血压的AF患者中RSDN联合PVI与单纯PVI相比影响的随机对照试验（RCT）。检索结果导入Covidence进行文章合格性筛选。共纳入6项RCT，涉及516例患者。在12个月时，与单纯PVI相比，RSDN+PVI的AF复发率[RR：0.58，95% CI（0.40；0.82），p=0.002，I2=28%]显著更低，而在24个月时未发现显著差异（p=0.93）。与单纯PVI相比，RSDN+PVI在12个月时显著降低收缩压（SBP）（MD：-13.41，95% CI=-15.59；-11.22，p<0.001，I2=88%），并在12个月时显著降低舒张压（DBP）（MD：-4.54，95% CI -7.66；-1.42，p=0.004，I2=81%）。本荟萃分析表明，在12个月时，PVI加辅助RSDN治疗组的SBP和DBP以及AF复发率均低于单纯PVI组。关键词：肾交感神经去支配术，肺静脉隔离，心房颤动，高血压，导管消融，抗心律失常治疗。

title: Mortality involving non-rheumatic valvular heart disease and atrial fibrillation in the United States: Long-term trends and implications.
summary: Non-Rheumatic valvular heart disease (NRVHD) and atrial fibrillation (AF) are major contributors to cardiovascular mortality in the U.S. Their coexistence increases the risk of stroke, heart failure, and death.This study examines national trends in deaths involving both NRVHD and AF in the United States from 1999 to 2023. Centers for disease control and prevention - Wide-Ranging Online Data for Epidemiologic Research data (1999-2023) were analyzed for adults with AF (I48) and NRVHD (I34-I36) as contributing causes of death. Age-adjusted mortality rates (AAMRs) were calculated per 100,000 population. Joinpoint regression analysis was used to determine average and annual percent change (AAPC) and annual percent change. From 1999 to 2023, a total of 141,846 deaths in the U.S. involved both AF and NRVHD. The AAMR increased from 2.98 in 1999 to 7.30 in 2023 (AAPC: 4.17; P < .001). Males had higher overall AAMR (5.31) (AAPC: 4.73) than females (4.02) (AAPC: 3.58). Non-hispanic Whites had the highest overall AAMR (5.17) while Hispanics had an AAMR of (1.88). Regionally, West had the highest overall AAMR (5.73), followed by the Northeast (4.81), the Midwest (4.79), and then the South (3.48). Majority of the deaths occurred in inpatient medical facilities (49,170 deaths, 35.0%). The age group 65 + showed the highest mortality (crude mortality rate: 11.93). Rural areas had higher overall AAMR (4.36) compared to urban areas (4.10). Deaths involving both AF and NRVHD increased from 1999 to 2023, with greater burden among older adults, males, rural areas, the West region, and non-Hispanic White population.

AI.tldr: 1999 至 2023 年美国涉及非风湿性瓣膜性心脏病（NRVHD）与房颤（AF）的死亡共 141,846 例，年龄标化死亡率从每 10 万人 2.98 升至 7.30，AAPC 为 4.17（P<0.001）；负担集中于老年人、男性、农村地区、西部地区和 NHW 人群。
AI.motivation: NRVHD 与 AF 共存会显著增加卒中、心力衰竭和死亡风险，是美国心血管死亡的重要来源；但既往研究很少针对“同时涉及 NRVHD 与 AF”这一特定死因组合，缺乏覆盖 20 余年的全国性长期趋势、人群差异和地域分布数据。本研究旨在填补这一证据缺口，为筛查和资源配置提供依据。
AI.method: 回顾性人群死因趋势研究。数据来自美国 CDC WONDER 数据库 1999—2023 年，纳入以 AF（ICD-10 I48）和 NRVHD（I34–I36）作为贡献死因的成人死亡记录，共 141,846 例。主要终点为年龄标化死亡率（AAMR，每 10 万人）；采用 Joinpoint 回归计算平均年度百分比变化（AAPC）和年度百分比变化，并按性别、种族和族裔、地区、城乡、死亡地点及年龄组分层。摘要未报告 95% 置信区间。
AI.result: AAMR 由 1999 年的 2.98 升至 2023 年的 7.30（AAPC 4.17；P<0.001）。男性总体 AAMR 为 5.31（AAPC 4.73），高于女性 4.02（AAPC 3.58）。非西班牙裔白人 AAMR 最高（5.17），西班牙裔为 1.88。地区分布以西部最高（5.73），其后依次为东北部 4.81、中西部 4.79、南部 3.48。死亡地点以住院医疗机构为主（49,170 例，35.0%）。65 岁以上人群粗死亡率最高（11.93）。农村地区总体 AAMR 为 4.36，高于城市地区的 4.10。
AI.conclusion: 近 25 年，NRVHD 与 AF 共同相关的死亡负担持续上升，且存在明显的人群和地域梯度：老年、男性、农村、西部及非西班牙裔白人人群负担更重。提示应对合并瓣膜病与 AF 的高危老年人加强节律管理、抗凝和瓣膜干预评估，并关注农村和西部的医疗资源可及性。局限性：研究基于死亡证明上的贡献死因编码，存在死因误分类和编码依赖；缺乏个体层面的用药、消融或瓣膜干预信息，无法推断因果；摘要仅报告中点估计，未提供 95%CI，也缺少与房颤消融、左心耳封堵等技术使用趋势的关联分析。

summary_zh: 非风湿性瓣膜性心脏病（NRVHD）和心房颤动（AF）是美国心血管死亡的主要原因。二者共存会增加卒中、心力衰竭和死亡风险。本研究分析1999年至2023年美国同时涉及NRVHD和AF的死亡的全国趋势。对美国疾病控制与预防中心（Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, CDC）的流行病学研究广泛在线数据（Wide-Ranging Online Data for Epidemiologic Research）数据（1999-2023）进行分析，纳入以AF（I48）和NRVHD（I34-I36）作为死亡促成原因的成人。年龄调整死亡率（AAMR）按每10万人计算。采用Joinpoint回归分析确定平均年度百分比变化（AAPC）和年度百分比变化。1999年至2023年，美国共有141,846例死亡同时涉及AF和NRVHD。AAMR从1999年的2.98升至2023年的7.30（AAPC：4.17；P < .001）。男性总体AAMR（5.31）（AAPC：4.73）高于女性（4.02）（AAPC：3.58）。非西班牙裔白人总体AAMR最高（5.17），而西班牙裔的AAMR为（1.88）。从地区看，西部总体AAMR最高（5.73），其次为东北部（4.81）、中西部（4.79），然后是南部（3.48）。大多数死亡发生在住院医疗机构（49,170例死亡，35.0%）。65岁及以上年龄组死亡率最高（粗死亡率：11.93）。农村地区总体AAMR（4.36）高于城市地区（4.10）。1999年至2023年，同时涉及AF和NRVHD的死亡增加，在老年人、男性、农村地区、西部地区和非西班牙裔白人人群中负担更重。

title: Impact of atrial fibrillation catheter ablation o'n tricuspid regurgitation severity: a systematic review and meta-analysis
Left Atrial Appendage Occlusion vs Oral Anticoagulation for Stroke Prevention in Atrial Fibrillation: A Meta-Analysis
summary: Background Left atrial appendage occlusion (LAAO) has emerged as a non-pharmacological alternative to oral anticoagulation (OAC) for stroke prevention in patients with atrial fibrillation (AF). Following the publication of recent CHAMPION-AF and CLOSURE-AF trials, an updated synthesis of evidence is warranted to clarify the long-term comparative efficacy and safety of LAAO versus OAC in patients with AF.Methods We conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials (RCTs) comparing LAAO with OAC in adults with AF. A comprehensive search of major databases was performed from inception to April 2026. The primary efficacy outcomes were major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE) and stroke. The primary safety outcome was non-procedure-related bleeding. Random-effects models were used to calculate pooled risk ratios (RRs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs).Results Six RCTs including 7,004 patients (3,681 LAAO; 3,323 OAC) were analyzed. No statistically significant difference was observed for MACE (7.5% vs 6.9%; RR 1.03, 95% CI 0.79-1.34) or stroke (3.7% vs 3.2%; RR 1.07, 95% CI 0.80-1.43). LAAO was associated with a significantly lower risk of non-procedure-related bleeding (9.8% vs 16.7%; RR 0.63, 95% CI 0.52-0.77), corresponding to an absolute risk reduction of 6.9% and an approximate number needed to treat of 15 based on crude pooled event rates over the observed trial follow-up. Trial sequential analysis indicated that the accumulated evidence for MACE and stroke remained inconclusive. Comparator-type subgroup analyses showed no significant interaction for MACE (p = 0.67) or stroke (p = 0.81) between contemporary predominantly-DOAC and VKA comparator trials.Conclusions LAAO was associated with lower non-procedure-related bleeding, while no statistically significant differences were observed for MACE or stroke. The available efficacy evidence remains inconclusive regarding equivalence or non-inferiority, and larger trials are needed. These findings support individualized consideration of LAAO when the long-term bleeding burden of anticoagulation is clinically important.

AI.tldr: 纳入6项RCT共7004例AF患者的荟萃分析显示，左心耳封堵（LAAO）与口服抗凝（OAC）在MACE和卒中风险上无显著差异，但LAAO显著降低非手术相关出血（RR 0.63）。
AI.motivation: LAAO 已成为房颤患者卒中预防的非药物替代方案，但既往证据多来自单药对照或非随机研究，长期疗效与安全性对比不清。随着 CHAMPION-AF 与 CLOSURE-AF 等新一代 RCT 公布，需要更新证据合成，明确 LAAO 相对 OAC 在有效性（MACE、卒中）与安全性（非手术相关出血）上的比较结果，为临床选择提供依据。
AI.method: 系统综述与荟萃分析，检索主要数据库自建库至2026年4月，纳入比较 LAAO 与 OAC 的成人房颤 RCT。共纳入6项 RCT、7004例患者（LAAO 3681例，OAC 3323例）。主要有效性终点为 MACE 与卒中，主要安全性终点为非手术相关出血。采用随机效应模型计算合并风险比（RR）及95%置信区间，并进行试验序贯分析及按对照类型（以 DOAC 为主 vs VKA）的亚组交互检验。
AI.result: MACE 发生率 LAAO 7.5% vs OAC 6.9%（RR 1.03，95%CI 0.79-1.34），卒中 3.7% vs 3.2%（RR 1.07，95%CI 0.80-1.43），均无统计学差异。LAAO 组非手术相关出血显著更低（9.8% vs 16.7%；RR 0.63，95%CI 0.52-0.77），绝对风险下降 6.9%，按粗合并事件率估算 NNT 约 15。试验序贯分析提示 MACE 与卒中的累积证据仍不具结论性。亚组分析显示，DOAC 为主与 VKA 对照试验间 MACE（交互 p=0.67）及卒中（交互 p=0.81）均无显著交互。
AI.conclusion: LAAO 可显著降低非手术相关出血，而 MACE 与卒中方面与 OAC 无统计学差异；但现有有效性证据尚不足以确证等效或非劣效，需更大规模 RCT 验证。临床实践中，当长期抗凝出血负担是重要考量时，可个体化考虑 LAAO。局限性包括事件数有限导致检验效能不足、随访时长与人群异质性，以及缺乏针对非劣效界值的正式检验。

summary_zh:
背景：左心耳封堵（LAAO）已成为口服抗凝（OAC）用于心房颤动（AF）患者卒中预防的非药物替代方案。在近期 CHAMPION-AF 和 CLOSURE-AF 试验发表后，有必要对证据进行更新综合，以阐明 LAAO 与 OAC 在 AF 患者中的长期比较疗效和安全性。

方法：我们对比较 LAAO 与 OAC 用于成人 AF 患者的随机对照试验（RCT）进行了系统评价和荟萃分析。对主要数据库从建库至 2026 年 4 月进行了全面检索。主要疗效结局为主要不良心血管事件（MACE）和卒中。主要安全性结局为非手术相关出血。使用随机效应模型计算合并风险比（RR）及 95% 置信区间（CI）。

结果：共分析 6 项 RCT，纳入 7,004 例患者（LAAO 3,681 例；OAC 3,323 例）。MACE（7.5% vs 6.9%；RR 1.03，95% CI 0.79-1.34）或卒中（3.7% vs 3.2%；RR 1.07，95% CI 0.80-1.43）均未观察到统计学显著差异。LAAO 与非手术相关出血风险显著降低相关（9.8% vs 16.7%；RR 0.63，95% CI 0.52-0.77），对应于绝对风险降低 6.9%，基于观察到的试验随访期间粗合并事件率，需治疗人数约为 15。试验序贯分析表明，MACE 和卒中的累积证据仍无定论。比较器类型亚组分析显示，在当代以 DOAC 为主和 VKA 作为对照的试验之间，MACE（p = 0.67）或卒中（p = 0.81）均无显著交互作用。

结论：LAAO 与非手术相关出血较低相关，而 MACE 或卒中未观察到统计学显著差异。现有疗效证据在等效性或非劣效性方面仍无定论，需要更大规模的试验。这些发现支持：当抗凝治疗的长期出血负担具有临床重要性时，应个体化考虑 LAAO。

title: Prediction of cardiovascular outcomes using electrocardiography from overnight polysomnography.
summary:
STUDY OBJECTIVES: Polysomnography (PSG) is the gold standard for diagnosing sleep disorders, which are recognized as cardiovascular risk factors. Single-lead electrocardiograms (ECGs) are recorded during PSG but rarely analyzed, presenting an opportunity to leverage overnight ECGs for cardiovascular risk prediction.

MATERIALS AND METHODS: We applied a deep residual neural network with attention to single-lead ECGs from PSG, combined with sleep stage data, to predict 10-year risk of atrial fibrillation (AF), stroke, myocardial infarction (MI), heart failure (HF), and death. The network, trained for arrhythmia detection, was finetuned on 15 809 Massachusetts General Hospital patients. External validation used cohorts from Emory University Hospital (EUH) (n = 9810) and Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center (BIDMC) (n = 12 576), with outcomes derived from electronic health records (ICD-9/10 codes).

RESULTS: Cox proportional hazards models showed that neural-network output (NN-output) was strongly associated with long-term cardiovascular risk (p < .0001), even after adjusting for risk factors (age, sex, body mass index, smoking, hypertension, diabetes) and sleep characteristics (apnea-hypopnea-index, arousal-index, periodic limb movement index, time spend in N1-N3, REM and sleep efficiency). A one-standard deviation increase in NN-output was associated with elevated hazard ratios (95% CI): AF 2.03 (1.82-2.27) (EUH) and 2.72 (2.31-3.21) (BIDMC); stroke 1.19 (1.09-1.31) and 1.40 (1.12-1.74); MI 1.38 (1.22-1.55) and 1.10 (0.86-1.40); HF 1.69 (1.55-1.85) and 2.33 (2.05-2.65); all-cause mortality 1.82 (1.60-2.06) and 1.65 (1.41-1.93).

CONCLUSIONS: Deep learning applied to nocturnal ECGs with sleep stage information captures cardiac abnormalities, offering a tool for cardiovascular risk stratification. Integrating such prediction into PSG could enhance detection and support personalized clinical decision-making.

AI.tldr: 基于夜间多导睡眠图单导联心电图的深度学习模型，在两家外部医院逾2.2万例患者中独立预测10年房颤、心衰、卒中及全因死亡风险，校正呼吸暂停等睡眠指标后关联依然显著。
AI.motivation: 睡眠障碍已被确认为心血管危险因素，而多导睡眠监测（PSG）常规记录的单导联心电图长期未被分析利用。既往心血管风险预测多依赖临床评分与常规危险因素，缺乏利用整夜心电数据的自动化工具，本研究旨在验证夜间心电信号能否用于长期心血管结局的风险分层。
AI.method: 回顾性建模与外部验证研究。采用带注意力机制的深度残差神经网络，输入PSG单导联心电图并结合睡眠分期信息，预测10年房颤、卒中、心肌梗死、心衰及死亡风险。模型先在麻省总医院15809例患者中预训练（心律失常检测）并微调；外部验证队列为Emory大学医院（EUH，n=9810）与Beth Israel Deaconess医学中心（BIDMC，n=12576），结局由电子病历ICD-9/10编码确定。采用Cox比例风险模型评估神经网络输出（NN-output）与结局的关联，校正年龄、性别、体重指数、吸烟、高血压、糖尿病及呼吸暂停低通气指数、觉醒指数、周期性肢体运动指数、N1-N3期与REM睡眠时间、睡眠效率。
AI.conclusion: 深度学习可从夜间单导联心电图联合睡眠分期中提取亚临床心脏异常信息，在独立外部队列中对房颤、心衰、卒中和全因死亡具有稳定预测价值，其效应独立于传统危险因素与睡眠呼吸指标。将此类预测嵌入PSG流程，有望在睡眠检查同时完成机会性心血管风险筛查，辅助个体化决策。局限性在于结局依赖ICD编码、缺少区分度与校准数据、外部验证为回顾性设计，且对心肌梗死的预测在BIDMC队列未达统计学显著，尚需前瞻性验证其临床效用。

summary_zh:
研究目的：多导睡眠图（PSG）是诊断睡眠障碍的金标准，而睡眠障碍已被认定为心血管危险因素。PSG 检查过程中会记录单导联心电图（ECG），但极少对其进行分析，这为利用整夜 ECG 进行心血管风险预测提供了机会。

材料与方法：我们将带有注意力机制的深度残差神经网络应用于 PSG 中的单导联 ECG，并结合睡眠分期数据，预测心房颤动（AF）、卒中、心肌梗死（MI）、心力衰竭（HF）和死亡的 10 年风险。该网络最初用于心律失常检测训练，随后在 15 809 例 Massachusetts General Hospital 患者中进行微调。外部验证使用 Emory University Hospital（EUH）（n = 9810）和 Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center（BIDMC）（n = 12 576）的队列，结局取自电子健康记录（ICD-9/10 编码）。

结果：Cox 比例风险模型显示，神经网络输出（NN-output）与长期心血管风险强烈相关（p < .0001），即使在校正危险因素（年龄、性别、体重指数、吸烟、高血压、糖尿病）和睡眠特征（呼吸暂停低通气指数、觉醒指数、周期性肢体运动指数、N1-N3 期、REM 期所占时间及睡眠效率）后依然如此。NN-output 每增加一个标准差，与以下风险比升高相关（95% CI）：AF 2.03（1.82-2.27）（EUH）和 2.72（2.31-3.21）（BIDMC）；卒中 1.19（1.09-1.31）和 1.40（1.12-1.74）；MI 1.38（1.22-1.55）和 1.10（0.86-1.40）；HF 1.69（1.55-1.85）和 2.33（2.05-2.65）；全因死亡 1.82（1.60-2.06）和 1.65（1.41-1.93）。

结论：将深度学习应用于夜间 ECG 并结合睡眠分期信息，可捕捉心脏异常，为心血管风险分层提供工具。将此类预测整合入 PSG 可提高检出率并支持个体化临床决策。

title: An Explainable Machine Learning Model Integrating Clinical Parameters for Identifying Left Atrial Appendage Thrombus in Non-valvular Atrial Fibrillation.
summary:
OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to develop a predictive model for left atrial appendage thrombus (LAAT) in patients with non-valvular atrial fibrillation by integrating clinical and echocardiographic features using machine learning algorithms. The SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) framework was applied to interpret the model and quantify the contribution of each predictor, thereby enhancing the accuracy and clinical interpretability of LAAT risk prediction.

METHODS: In this retrospective study, 325 patients with non-valvular atrial fibrillation who underwent transesophageal echocardiography at our institution between September 2022 and October 2024 were included. Least absolute shrinkage and selection operator regression with fivefold cross-validation was performed exclusively within the training cohort to select candidate features, followed by multivariable logistic regression to quantify independent associations. Six machine learning algorithms-logistic regression, support vector classifier, random forest, GradientBoosting, Extreme Gradient Boosting and Light Gradient Boosting Machine-were then trained and evaluated for model construction. The SHAP analysis was subsequently used to visualize and interpret the impact of each feature on model prediction.

RESULTS: Multivariable logistic regression identified lower LAA blood flow velocity (odds ratio, 0.805; p < 0.001) and persistent atrial fibrillation (odds ratio, 4.344; p = 0.005) as independent predictors of LAAT. Among the six models, logistic regression demonstrated the best predictive performance, with an area under the curve of 0.958 in the training cohort and 0.913 in the test cohort. SHAP interpretation revealed that LAA blood flow velocity, atrial fibrillation type, left atrial diameter, CHA₂DS₂-VASc score (congestive heart failure, hypertension, age ≥75 years, diabetes mellitus, stroke/transient ischemic attack, vascular disease, age 65-74 years, sex category [female]), left ventricular ejection fraction and fibrinogen were the most influential features contributing to thrombus risk prediction.

CONCLUSION: By combining machine learning algorithms with the SHAP interpretability framework, this study successfully developed an efficient and explainable model for predicting LAAT in patients with non-valvular atrial fibrillation. The proposed model integrates readily available clinical and echocardiographic variables, providing a practical tool to assist in individualized anticoagulation management and clinical decision-making.

AI.tldr: 在325例非瓣膜性房颤患者中，整合左心耳血流速度、房颤类型等临床与超声特征构建可解释机器学习模型预测左心耳血栓，logistic回归模型测试集AUC达0.913。
AI.motivation: 非瓣膜性房颤患者左心耳血栓（LAAT）是心源性卒中的直接原因，但常规依靠CHA₂DS₂-VASc评分进行抗凝决策，无法直接反映左心耳局部血流淤滞状态；既往预测模型多为传统回归模型，判别效能有限且缺乏可解释性，临床难以据此进行个体化抗凝。本研究拟结合机器学习与SHAP可解释框架，构建兼顾准确性与可解释性的LAAT预测模型。
AI.method: 单中心回顾性研究，纳入2022年9月至2024年10月在本院接受经食管超声心动图（TEE）检查的非瓣膜性房颤患者325例。仅在训练集中采用五折交叉验证的LASSO回归筛选候选特征，随后以多因素logistic回归量化独立关联；再训练并比较logistic回归、支持向量分类器、随机森林、GradientBoosting、XGBoost、LightGBM六种机器学习算法，以AUC评价模型，并用SHAP框架可视化各特征对预测的贡献。训练集与测试集的划分比例、LAAT阳性例数及终点定义细节摘要未报告。
AI.result: 多因素logistic回归显示，左心耳血流速度降低（OR 0.805，P<0.001）与持续性房颤（OR 4.344，P=0.005）为LAAT的独立预测因素。六种模型中logistic回归判别效能最佳，训练集AUC 0.958、测试集AUC 0.913。SHAP分析显示，对血栓风险预测贡献最大的特征依次为左心耳血流速度、房颤类型、左房内径、CHA₂DS₂-VASc评分、左室射血分数和纤维蛋白原。各模型的敏感度、特异度及AUC的95%置信区间摘要未报告。
AI.conclusion: 将机器学习与SHAP可解释框架结合，可基于常规可得的临床与超声心动图变量构建高效、可解释的LAAT预测模型，有助于个体化抗凝管理和临床决策。局限性在于为单中心回顾性设计、样本量有限、缺乏外部验证，且模型尚未与现有风险评分进行头对头比较，其临床落地价值需前瞻性多中心研究证实。

summary_zh:
目的：本研究旨在通过使用机器学习算法整合临床和超声心动图特征，开发用于识别非瓣膜性心房颤动患者左心耳血栓（LAAT）的预测模型。应用SHapley Additive exPlanations（SHAP）框架解释模型并量化每个预测变量的贡献，从而提高LAAT风险预测的准确性和临床可解释性。

方法：在这项回顾性研究中，纳入2022年9月至2024年10月期间在本机构接受经食管超声心动图的325例非瓣膜性心房颤动患者。仅在训练队列中采用五折交叉验证的最小绝对收缩和选择算子回归筛选候选特征，随后使用多变量logistic回归量化独立关联。随后训练和评估六种机器学习算法——logistic回归、支持向量分类器、随机森林、GradientBoosting、Extreme Gradient Boosting和Light Gradient Boosting Machine——以构建模型。随后使用SHAP分析可视化并解释每个特征对模型预测的影响。

结果：多变量logistic回归确定较低的左心耳血流速度（比值比，0.805；p < 0.001）和持续性心房颤动（比值比，4.344；p = 0.005）是LAAT的独立预测因素。在六种模型中，logistic回归表现出最佳的预测性能，训练队列中的曲线下面积为0.958，测试队列中为0.913。SHAP解释显示，左心耳血流速度、心房颤动类型、左心房内径、CHA₂DS₂-VASc评分（充血性心力衰竭、高血压、年龄≥75岁、糖尿病、卒中/短暂性脑缺血发作、血管疾病、年龄65-74岁、性别类别[女性]）、左心室射血分数和纤维蛋白原是促成血栓风险预测的最具影响力的特征。

结论：通过将机器学习算法与SHAP可解释性框架相结合，本研究成功开发了一种高效且可解释的模型，用于预测非瓣膜性心房颤动患者的LAAT。所提出的模型整合了易于获取的临床和超声心动图变量，为辅助个体化抗凝管理和临床决策提供了一种实用工具。

title: From Sudden Cardiac Death Prevention to Performance Optimization: A Conceptual Framework for Cardiovascular Assessment in Elite Athletes.
summary: Cardiovascular pre-participation evaluation in elite athletes primarily aims to identify cardiovascular conditions associated with sudden cardiac death. Current international recommendations emphasize comprehensive medical history, physical examination, and resting 12-lead electrocardiography (ECG), with additional investigations guided by clini-cal findings and individual risk. However, advances in sports cardiology, cardiovascular imaging, and exercise physiology provide opportunities to integrate cardiovascular risk assessment with physiological performance evaluation. This article proposes a concep-tual, hypothesis-generating framework integrating structural, electrical, and functional cardiovascular assessment in elite athletes. The framework consists of 3 sequential components: comprehensive clinical assessment with resting ECG; transthoracic echo-cardiography for structural evaluation and longitudinal reference; and cardiopulmonary exercise testing (CPET) as an optional complementary investigation. Cardiopulmonary exercise testing may provide information on maximal oxygen uptake, ventilatory thresh-olds, oxygen pulse, ventilatory efficiency, heart rate recovery, and exercise-induced arrhythmias, potentially supporting individualized training prescription and longitudinal physiological monitoring. Cardiac magnetic resonance and coronary computed tomog-raphy angiography (CCTA) may be considered selectively when clinically indicated. A one-time CCTA strategy during an athlete's career is proposed as a research hypothesis requiring prospective assessment of clinical utility and cost-effectiveness. Importantly, CPET and CCTA are not proposed as universal screening requirements. This framework is intended to complement, rather than replace, current evidence-based international recommendations. As the proposed model is based on available literature and expert opinion and has not undergone prospective clinical validation, future multicenter stud-ies are required to determine whether integrated cardiovascular assessment improves risk stratification, athlete safety, clinical decision-making, performance monitoring, and cost-effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出针对精英运动员的三步式心血管评估概念框架：临床评估联合静息12导联心电图、经胸超声心动图、可选的心肺运动试验，试图把猝死风险筛查与运动表现评估整合起来，但目前尚无前瞻性验证。
AI.motivation: 精英运动员赛前心血管评估的核心目标是识别与心源性猝死相关的疾病，现行国际建议以病史、体格检查和静息12导联心电图为基础，附加检查则由临床发现与个体风险决定。随着运动心脏病学、心血管影像和运动生理学的发展，已具备将心血管风险评估与生理表现评估整合的条件，但迄今缺乏系统化的整合框架，这正是本文试图填补的缺口。
AI.method: 本文为概念性、以生成假设为目的的文章，不是原创临床研究，未纳入研究人群，也未报告样本量（摘要未报告）。作者提出一个由三个序贯部分组成的框架：①全面临床评估联合静息12导联心电图；②经胸超声心动图用于结构评估并作为纵向参照；③心肺运动试验（CPET）作为可选的补充检查。心脏磁共振与冠状动脉CT血管成像（CCTA）仅在临床有指征时选择性使用；作者还把“运动员职业生涯中行一次性CCTA”作为有待前瞻性评估的研究假设提出，并明确 CPET 与 CCTA 都不是普适筛查项目。CPET 可提供最大摄氧量、通气阈值、氧脉搏、通气效率、心率恢复及运动诱发心律失常等信息。统计方法：摘要未报告（本文未开展统计分析）。
AI.result: 摘要未报告任何定量结果、效应量、95% 置信区间或 P 值；本文基于现有文献与专家意见进行框架描述，未经过前瞻性临床验证。作者强调该框架属于补充性工具，并非替代现行循证国际建议，CPET 与 CCTA 也不作为所有运动员的常规筛查要求。
AI.conclusion: 该框架的临床意义在于提示：在现有猝死筛查基础上叠加结构与功能评估，可能有助于个体化训练处方与纵向生理监测；但其对风险分层、运动员安全、临床决策、表现监测及成本效益的实际影响尚属未知，需通过多中心前瞻性研究验证。局限性包括：纯概念性、无前瞻性数据支持、CCTA 一次性策略的临床效用与成本效益均未评估。对电生理实践而言，目前不宜据此改变筛查路径。

summary_zh: 精英运动员的心血管赛前评估主要旨在识别与心脏性猝死相关的心血管疾病。现行国际建议强调全面的病史采集、体格检查和静息12导联心电图（ECG），并根据临床表现和个体风险决定是否进行进一步检查。然而，运动心脏病学、心血管影像学和运动生理学的进展为将心血管风险评估与生理性能评估相结合提供了机会。本文提出一个概念性的、用于产生假设的框架，在精英运动员中整合结构性、电学和功能性心血管评估。该框架由3个序贯组成部分构成：包含静息ECG的全面临床评估；用于结构评估和纵向参照的经胸超声心动图；以及作为可选补充检查的心肺运动试验（CPET）。心肺运动试验可提供关于最大摄氧量、通气阈值、氧脉搏、通气效率、心率恢复和运动诱发心律失常的信息，可能有助于制定个体化训练处方和进行纵向生理监测。心脏磁共振和冠状动脉计算机断层扫描血管成像（CCTA）可在有临床指征时选择性考虑。在运动员职业生涯中实施一次CCTA的策略是作为一个研究假设提出的，需要前瞻性评估其临床效用和成本效益。重要的是，CPET和CCTA并非作为普遍筛查要求提出。该框架旨在补充而非取代现行基于证据的国际建议。由于所提出的模型基于现有文献和专家意见，尚未经过前瞻性临床验证，因此需要未来的多中心研究来确定整合性心血管评估是否能改善风险分层、运动员安全性、临床决策、性能监测和成本效益。

title: Post-induction residual time: a novel sensing phenomenon during induced ventricular fibrillation in subcutaneous ICD recipients.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Subcutaneous implantable cardioverter defibrillators (S-ICD) are extensively used in the primary and secondary prevention of sudden cardiac death. Ventricular fibrillation (VF) induction during implantation remains standard to confirm device functionality.

OBJECTIVE: To compare electrocardiographic (ECG) and technical variables between induced and spontaneous ventricular arrhythmias in S-ICD recipients.

METHODS: A retrospective observational study was performed on 10 consecutive patients with S-ICD. Variables included episode duration, sensing time, charge time, and shock impedance. For each patient, the implant induced VF episode was compared to at least one spontaneous event during follow-up.

RESULTS: The mean age was 36.4 years (range: 22-61); 2 patients were male. All patients received intermuscular S-ICD implants, with the lead placed in the left parasternal position in 7 patients and right parasternal in 3. Episode duration and sensing time were consistently shorter in spontaneous events, and shock impedance was lower. Charge time, however, was longer in spontaneous events (by 1.4 to 1.8 s).

CONCLUSIONS: In this case series, spontaneous ventricular arrhythmic events in S-ICD patients demonstrated shorter sensing and therapy delivery times compared with induced ventricular fibrillation episodes. A measurable Post-Induction Residual Time (PRT) was identified in all induced episodes and was absent during spontaneous ventricular arrhythmias, suggesting that 50-Hz-induced VF may not fully reproduce spontaneous arrhythmic events from the perspective of device sensing performance. These findings support the hypothesis that part of the delay observed during implant testing may be related to the induction process itself rather than to the intrinsic sensing capabilities of the S-ICD. Further studies are warranted to confirm these observations and to evaluate alternative VF induction strategies in future device platforms. Future integration of S-ICD systems with leadless pacing technologies may provide alternative ventricular fibrillation induction strategies, including T-wave shock delivery during either sensed intrinsic rhythm or leadless-paced rhythm. Such approaches could potentially avoid the occurrence of Post-Induction Residual Time (PRT) and may provide a model that more closely reproduces spontaneous ventricular fibrillation than current 50-Hz induction techniques.

AI.tldr: 10例S-ICD患者中，诱发性VF的感知时间与事件持续时间均长于自发性室性心律失常，并出现诱后残余时间（PRT），提示50 Hz诱颤未能完全模拟自发事件。
AI.motivation: 皮下植入式心律转复除颤器（S-ICD）已广泛用于心脏性猝死的一级与二级预防，植入时以50 Hz交流电诱发心室颤动（VF）验证设备感知与除颤功能仍是常规流程。然而，诱发VF能否真实反映患者自发室性心律失常时的感知表现尚不清楚；既往研究多为设备整体性能的横断面评估，缺乏同一患者体内诱发事件与自发事件的直接配对比较，可能导致对S-ICD感知能力的误判。
AI.method: 单中心回顾性观察性研究，连续纳入10例S-ICD患者（平均年龄36.4岁，范围22–61岁；男性2例），全部采用肌间囊袋植入，导联位于左旁胸骨7例、右旁胸骨3例。对每例患者，将植入时50 Hz诱发的VF事件与随访期间至少1次自发性室性心律失常事件进行自身对照比较；观察变量包括事件持续时间、感知时间、充电时间与除颤阻抗。摘要未报告具体统计学方法与P值。
AI.result: 自发事件的事件持续时间与感知时间均一致短于诱发事件，除颤阻抗也更低；相反，自发事件的充电时间较诱发事件延长1.4–1.8 s。在所有诱发VF事件中均可测得“诱后残余时间（PRT）”，而在自发室性心律失常中PRT不存在。摘要未报告各参数的绝对值、离散程度、95%置信区间及P值。

背景：皮下植入式心律转复除颤器（S-ICD）广泛用于心脏性猝死的一级和二级预防。植入过程中进行心室颤动（VF）诱导仍是确认器械功能的常规做法。

目的：比较S-ICD植入者中诱导性与自发性室性心律失常之间的心电图（ECG）及技术参数。

方法：对10例连续接受S-ICD的患者进行回顾性观察性研究。变量包括发作持续时间、感知时间、充电时间和放电阻抗。对每例患者，将植入时诱导的VF发作与随访期间至少一次自发性事件进行比较。

结果：平均年龄为36.4岁（范围：22-61）；2例患者为男性。所有患者均接受肌间S-ICD植入，其中7例导线置于左侧胸骨旁位置，3例置于右侧胸骨旁位置。自发性事件的发作持续时间和感知时间均一致地更短，且放电阻抗更低。然而，自发性事件的充电时间更长（长1.4至1.8秒）。

结论：在本病例系列中，S-ICD患者的自发性室性心律失常事件相较于诱导性心室颤动发作，表现出更短的感知时间和治疗发放时间。所有诱导发作中均可识别出可测量的诱导后残余时间（PRT），而在自发性室性心律失常期间该时间缺失，提示从器械感知性能的角度看，50 Hz诱导的VF可能无法完全再现自发性心律失常事件。这些发现支持以下假设：植入测试期间观察到的部分延迟可能与诱导过程本身有关，而非与S-ICD的固有感知能力有关。仍需进一步研究以证实这些观察结果，并在未来的器械平台中评估替代性VF诱导策略。未来S-ICD系统与无导线起搏技术的整合可能提供替代性心室颤动诱导策略，包括在感知到的自身心律或无导线起搏心律期间发放T波电击。此类方法有可能避免诱导后残余时间（PRT）的出现，并可能提供一种比当前50 Hz诱导技术更接近再现自发性心室颤动的模型。

title: Clinical Characteristics and Transplacental Treatment of Fetal Ventricular Tachycardia: A Nationwide Survey in Japan.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Fetal ventricular tachycardia (VT) is an ultra-rare form of tachyarrhythmia, and no established management strategy currently exists.

OBJECTIVES: This study aimed to clarify the current diagnostic and management approaches for fetal VT.

METHODS: A nationwide survey of suspected fetal VT was conducted across 77 tertiary referral facilities in Japan between 2014 and 2023.

RESULTS: In total, 24 fetal VT cases from 18 facilities were analyzed. Twenty cases were diagnosed based on atrioventricular dissociation. Four were initially diagnosed as supraventricular tachycardia. VT occurred by 32 6/7 weeks of gestation in all nine long QT syndrome (LQTS) cases (LQT 2 in six, LQT 3 in two, and other in one), whereas 8/15 non-LQTS cases occurred at term. Eight of 20 cases managed as fetal VT, and three of four cases managed as fetal supraventricular tachycardia received fetal treatment. Fetal treatments were effective in 9/11 cases overall and in 8/9 LQTS cases. Side effects were observed in 6/11 cases; however, no serious adverse events occurred, except one case of lidocaine toxicity. After birth, LQTS cases were more likely to be refractory to treatment than non-LQT cases (8/9 vs. 6/14), requiring multidisciplinary management. Neurodevelopmental delay was more frequent in LQTS cases than in non-LQTS cases (6/9 vs. 2/14).

CONCLUSIONS: Transplacental treatment is highly recommended for preterm fetal VT. In particular, in cases of fetal VT diagnosed before 33 weeks of gestation, aggressive fetal treatment including magnesium sulfate and β-blockers should be considered with the possibility of LQT 2 or 3.

背景：胎儿室性心动过速（VT）是一种极为罕见的心律失常类型，目前尚无公认的管理策略。

目的：本研究旨在阐明目前胎儿VT的诊断和管理方法。

方法：2014年至2023年间，在日本77家三级转诊机构开展了一项针对疑似胎儿VT的全国性调查。

结论：对于早产胎儿VT，强烈推荐经胎盘治疗。特别是对于妊娠33周前诊断的胎儿VT病例，应考虑积极进行胎儿治疗，包括硫酸镁和β受体阻滞剂，并考虑到LQT 2或3的可能性。

title: Identifying the High-Risk Arrhythmic Mitral Valve Prolapse Phenotype by Imaging
summary: Within arrhythmogenic mitral valve prolapse (AMVP), a distinct subset of mitral valve prolapse (MVP), there is a small group that carries a higher risk of malignant ventricular arrhythmias and sudden cardiac death called malignant MVP. The malignant MVP phenotype is over-represented in young women with unexplained sudden cardiac death on autopsy. AMVP is defined by myxomatous, often bileaflet MVP with mitral annular disjunction, abnormal valvular-myocardial mechanics, complex ventricular ectopy, and nonsustained ventricular tachycardia. Excessive mechanical force from systolic annular expansion, papillary muscle traction, and basal inferolateral "curling" promotes focal replacement and diffuse interstitial fibrosis, creating an arrhythmogenic substrate. Premature ventricular contractions act as triggers, whereas autonomic modulation influences the timing of ventricular arrhythmia initiation and progression to ventricular fibrillation or sustained monomorphic ventricular tachycardia. Baseline evaluation with an electrocardiogram and transthoracic echocardiography is necessary to identify AMVP, exclude severe mitral regurgitation, and identify high-risk markers. If no premature ventricular contractions are found on a resting electrocardiogram, exercise stress testing and extended rhythm monitoring can help bring out ventricular premature contractions, which are triggers of ventricular arrhythmias. Cardiac magnetic resonance provides incremental prognostic value with late gadolinium enhancement reflecting replacement fibrosis and T1 mapping identifying diffuse fibrosis, even in those with no late gadolinium enhancement. Machine-learning analysis may further refine risk stratification by integrating high-risk features such as mitral annular disjunction, fibrosis extent, and location that outperform symptom-based assessment. As transcatheter and surgical mitral interventions expand, accurate phenotyping of AMVP is increasingly important, as hemodynamic correction of mitral regurgitation alone does not eliminate the underlying arrhythmogenic substrate. Comprehensive multimodality imaging and integrated rhythm assessment are therefore central to individualized risk stratification and management in this vulnerable population.

AI.tldr: 该综述指出，高危致心律失常性二尖瓣脱垂（AMVP）表型应通过基础心电与超声、运动负荷试验和延长节律监测、心脏磁共振（LGE与T1 mapping）以及机器学习整合的多模态影像路径来识别，单纯纠正二尖瓣反流不能消除致心律失常基质。
AI.motivation: AMVP是二尖瓣脱垂（MVP）中一个独特的亚型，其中"恶性MVP"亚组发生恶性室性心律失常和心源性猝死的风险更高，而且在年轻女性不明原因猝死者的尸检中占比过高。既往主要依靠症状进行风险分层，对黏液样瓣膜、二尖瓣环分离（MAD）所致的瓣膜-心肌机械力学异常以及由此产生的致心律失常基质缺乏系统的影像学识别手段；与此同时，随着经导管和外科二尖瓣干预不断扩大，仅以血流动力学纠正二尖瓣反流为目标的做法暴露出明显缺口，因此需要明确高危表型，以指导个体化的风险分层与管理。
AI.method: 本文为综述性文章，摘要未报告原始研究人群、样本量、干预措施或终点定义，也未报告统计方法。文中梳理并整合了以下评估策略：以静息心电图和经胸超声心动图作为基础筛查，用于识别AMVP、排除重度二尖瓣反流并发现高危标志；如果静息心电图未发现室性早搏，则采用运动负荷试验和延长节律监测来诱发室性早搏，后者是室性心律失常的触发因素；心脏磁共振通过晚期钆增强（LGE）反映替代性纤维化，并通过T1 mapping识别弥漫性间质纤维化，即使没有LGE表现者亦适用；此外，利用机器学习分析，将二尖瓣环分离、纤维化范围和部位等高风险特征加以整合，以优化风险分层。
AI.result: 摘要未报告原始研究的效应量、95%置信区间或P值。综述归纳的关键要点包括：AMVP的界定要素为黏液样、常为双叶脱垂并伴MAD、瓣膜-心肌机械力学异常、复杂室性早搏以及非持续性室性心动过速；机制上，收缩期瓣环扩张、乳头肌牵拉和基底下侧壁"卷曲"所产生的过度机械力，会促进局灶性替代性纤维化和弥漫性间质纤维化，从而形成致心律失常基质；室性早搏起触发作用，自主神经调节则影响室性心律失常的起始时机及其向心室颤动或持续性单形性室性心动过速的进展；心脏磁共振具有增量预后价值；机器学习整合MAD、纤维化范围与部位的风险分层表现优于以症状为基础的评估。
AI.conclusion: 结论是：对AMVP进行准确表型分型，并联合多模态影像与节律评估，是该脆弱人群个体化风险分层和管理的核心。对电生理实践的影响在于：评估MVP患者时应主动筛查MAD、复杂室性早搏与纤维化负荷，并在考虑器械植入或消融时纳入这些影像学基质标志；即使外科或经导管手术成功纠正二尖瓣反流，仍需持续进行心律失常风险评估。局限在于：本文为综述，相关影像学指标缺乏统一阈值，也缺乏前瞻性验证与随机对照证据，机器学习的风险模型尚未在临床中广泛验证。

summary_zh: 在致心律失常性二尖瓣脱垂（AMVP）——二尖瓣脱垂（MVP）中的一个独特亚型——内部，存在一小组发生恶性室性心律失常和心源性猝死风险更高的患者，称为恶性MVP。恶性MVP表型在尸检时发现不明原因心源性猝死的年轻女性中占比过高。AMVP的定义为黏液样、常为双叶MVP并伴二尖瓣环分离、瓣膜-心肌力学异常、复杂性室性异位搏动及非持续性室性心动过速。收缩期瓣环扩张、乳头肌牵拉以及基底段下侧壁“卷曲”所产生的过度机械力，促进局灶性替代性纤维化和弥漫性间质纤维化，从而形成致心律失常基质。室性期前收缩起触发作用，而自主神经调节影响室性心律失常启动及进展为心室颤动或持续性单形性室性心动过速的时机。基线评估需进行心电图和经胸超声心动图检查，以识别AMVP、排除重度二尖瓣反流并识别高风险标志物。若静息心电图未发现室性期前收缩，运动负荷试验和延长节律监测有助于诱发出室性期前收缩，而后者是室性心律失常的触发因素。心脏磁共振提供增量预后价值：晚期钆增强反映替代性纤维化，T1 mapping识别弥漫性纤维化，即使在无晚期钆增强的患者中亦然。机器学习分析可通过整合二尖瓣环分离、纤维化范围和位置等高风险特征，进一步细化风险分层，这些特征优于基于症状的评估。随着经导管和外科二尖瓣干预的扩展，对AMVP进行准确表型分型日益重要，因为仅对二尖瓣反流进行血流动力学矫正并不能消除潜在的致心律失常基质。因此，全面多模态成像和整合性节律评估对于这一脆弱人群的个体化风险分层和管理至关重要。

title: Multimodality Imaging-Guided Ventricular Tachycardia Ablation in a Hypoplastic Right Ventricle After Glenn Palliation.
summary: Adults with single-ventricle physiology increasingly survive into adulthood and may develop complex ventricular arrhythmias. A 44-year-old man with severe right ventricular hypoplasia and previous bidirectional Glenn palliation presented with sustained monomorphic ventricular tachycardia. Transthoracic and intracardiac echocardiography, computed tomography, and high-density electroanatomic mapping were combined to reconstruct the right-sided anatomy and to characterize the arrhythmogenic substrate. Intracardiac echocardiographic contours were merged with the electroanatomic map to build the geometry of the rudimentary right ventricle, in which extensive low-voltage areas were identified, with the latest and most fragmented late potentials confined to the anterior right ventricular outflow tract. Programmed stimulation did not induce ventricular tachycardia; however, pace mapping within the late-potential region reproduced the clinical QRS morphology with a stimulus-to-QRS interval of 153 milliseconds. Ablation was therefore guided by substrate homogenization, and a postablation high-density remap confirmed abolition of all late potentials. A subcutaneous implantable cardioverter-defibrillator was implanted before discharge.

AI.tldr: 一例44岁右心室严重发育不良、既往行双向Glenn术后患者发生持续性单形性室速，经多模态影像与高密度标测指导，以基质均质化消融消除全部晚电位，出院前植入皮下ICD。
AI.motivation: 单心室生理患者存活至成年者逐渐增多，可合并复杂室性心律失常；但右心发育不良、Glenn术后患者右室结构极度变形、心腔狭小，常规标测与消融路径受限，此类人群的致心律失常基质定位与消融策略缺乏报道证据。
AI.method: 个案报道（JACC Case Rep）。对象为1例44岁男性，右心室严重发育不良、既往行双向Glenn姑息术，表现为持续性单形性室速。采用经胸超声心动图、心腔内超声（ICE）、心脏CT与高密度三维电解剖标测联合重建右心解剖并刻画致心律失常基质；将ICE勾勒的心内膜轮廓与电解剖图融合，构建残存右室几何模型，行基质标测、程序电刺激与起搏标测，以基质均质化为消融策略，消融后再次高密度标测验证晚电位是否消失。样本量、终点定义与统计方法：摘要未报告（个案报道，未涉及组间统计比较）。
AI.result: 标测显示残存右室存在大片低电压区，最晚且最碎裂的晚电位局限于右室流出道前壁。程序电刺激未诱发室速；但在晚电位区域内起搏可复制临床室速的QRS形态，刺激—QRS间期为153 ms。据此以基质均质化为目标消融，消融后高密度重新标测证实全部晚电位被消除。出院前植入皮下植入式心律转复除颤器（S-ICD）。随访时长与复发情况：摘要未报告。
AI.conclusion: 对于右心发育不良、Glenn术后的单形性室速患者，融合ICE与高密度电解剖标测可克服解剖变形带来的标测困难，精准定位晚电位区域；在程序刺激不能诱发的条件下，起搏标测（刺激—QRS 153 ms）结合基质均质化消融可作为可行的消融策略，并以消融后重新标测确认基质消除，同时以S-ICD提供后备保护。局限性为单例经验，缺乏随访与复发数据，技术可推广性尚待更多病例验证。

summary_zh: 单心室生理的成人患者越来越多地存活至成年，并可能发生复杂的室性心律失常。一名44岁男性，患有严重右心室发育不良，既往接受过双向Glenn姑息术，表现为持续性单形性室性心动过速。将经胸超声心动图、心腔内超声心动图、计算机断层扫描与高密度电解剖标测相结合，以重建右侧解剖结构并明确致心律失常基质。将心腔内超声心动图的轮廓与电解剖标测图融合，构建发育不良右心室的几何结构，其中识别出广泛的低电压区，最晚且最为碎裂的晚电位局限于右心室流出道前部。程序电刺激未诱发室性心动过速；然而，在晚电位区域内进行起搏标测可复制临床QRS形态，刺激至QRS间期为153毫秒。因此以基质均质化为指导进行消融，消融后高密度重新标测证实所有晚电位均被消除。出院前植入皮下植入式心律转复除颤器。

title: Rapid Radiological Disappearance of Pancreatic Duct Stones Following Oral Trimethadione
summary: A 59-year-old man with chronic pancreatitis, surgically altered anatomy, and an implantable cardioverter-defibrillator presented with acute exacerbation caused by cast-like obstructive pancreatic duct stones. Endoscopic therapy was considered technically difficult, and extracorporeal shock wave lithotripsy was avoided. While delayed surgical drainage was being considered, off-label oral trimethadione was started after institutional ethics approval. Computed tomography 2 weeks later showed disappearance of the stones and improvement of ductal dilatation. No adverse events occurred, and surgery was deferred. This case suggests that trimethadione may be a potential salvage option when standard interventions are infeasible.

AI.tldr: 一例59岁慢性胰腺炎、外科改变解剖并植入ICD的患者，因铸型梗阻性胰管结石急性加重，在标准干预不可行的情况下超说明书口服三甲双酮，2周后复查CT结石消失、胰管扩张改善，无不良事件。
AI.motivation: 慢性胰腺炎合并铸型梗阻性胰管结石可导致急性加重；当内镜治疗技术困难、体外冲击波碎石又不宜进行时，临床缺乏可用的微创替代方案，只能等待延期手术引流。既往对三甲双酮用于溶解胰管结石的证据十分有限，因此在标准干预均不可行的情况下，需要探索可能的药物挽救治疗。
AI.method: 个案报道，共1例。患者为59岁男性，患有慢性胰腺炎，既往外科手术改变了消化道解剖，并植入植入式心律转复除颤器（ICD）；本次因铸型梗阻性胰管结石导致急性加重。评估认为内镜治疗技术困难，并避免使用体外冲击波碎石（ESWL）；在等待延期手术引流期间，经机构伦理批准后开始超说明书口服三甲双酮。观察终点为治疗后CT影像上结石与胰管扩张的变化，以及不良事件。摘要未报告药物剂量、给药疗程及实验室监测指标。
AI.result: 开始口服三甲双酮2周后，复查计算机断层扫描（CT）显示结石消失，胰管扩张改善。摘要未报告结石大小、胰管直径等具体测量数值。治疗期间无不良事件发生，原计划的延期手术被取消。随访时长摘要未报告。
AI.conclusion: 本病例提示，当内镜治疗与体外冲击波碎石均不可行时，口服三甲双酮可能成为铸型胰管结石的一种挽救性选择，并可能使患者免于手术。但该证据仅为单例观察，缺少对照、剂量与药代动力学数据，且随访时间短，不能据此推广至常规临床实践；对植入ICD的患者，用药期间仍需关注药物相互作用与电解质、心电监测。需要进一步的前瞻性研究验证其疗效与安全性。

summary_zh: 一名59岁男性，患有慢性胰腺炎、外科手术改变了解剖结构，并植入植入式心律转复除颤器，因铸型样阻塞性胰管结石导致急性加重就诊。考虑内镜治疗技术难度大，未采用体外冲击波碎石术。在考虑延迟外科引流的同时，经机构伦理批准后，开始超说明书口服三甲双酮。2周后的计算机断层扫描显示结石消失，胰管扩张改善。未发生不良事件，手术被推迟。本病例提示，当标准干预不可行时，三甲双酮可能是一种潜在的挽救性选择。

title: Do pacemakers prolong the dying process in a palliative setting?-a retrospective matched cohort analysis.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Clinicians caring for end-of-life patients regularly receive questions from patients and relatives about whether the pacemaker (PM) has to be deactivated. The possible life-prolonging effect of an active PM on the dying process of a palliative patient remains a scientific and clinical question in the literature and is a challenge for caregivers and patients in the end-of-life phase. This study analyzed whether there is a possible life-prolonging effect of an active PM in palliative patients.

METHODS: The time that 83 terminal palliative PM patients passed at a palliative care until death is compared with the time that 163 matched control terminal non-PM patients passed at the same palliative care unit (PCU). The non-PM patients are matched for age, gender, and underlying diseases.

RESULTS: The survival curves of PM and matched control non-PM patients were, for most of the time, exactly superimposed. Some PM patients died in the period 10-45 days after intake at the PCU a few days earlier than the control patients. This may be explained by their higher cardiovascular morbidity, more frequent previous cardiac surgery, more diabetes mellitus, and impaired kidney function.

CONCLUSIONS: There is no evidence that an active PM prolongs the dying process in terminal PCU patients; a few PM patients died even earlier than their matched control non-PM patients.

AI.tldr: 回顾性匹配队列显示，终末期姑息治疗患者中活动性起搏器未延长死亡过程，部分起搏器患者甚至更早死亡。
AI.motivation: 终末期患者及家属常询问起搏器是否需要关闭；活动性起搏器是否延长姑息患者濒死过程缺乏明确证据，给临床沟通与决策带来困难。
AI.method: 回顾性匹配队列分析，比较83例终末期起搏器患者与163例按年龄、性别及基础疾病匹配的非起搏器对照，均入住同一姑息治疗病房；观察从入院至死亡的时间，采用生存曲线比较。摘要未报告具体匹配方法、统计模型及效应量。
AI.result: 起搏器组与匹配非起搏器组的生存曲线在大部分时间几乎重合；部分起搏器患者在入院后10–45天死亡，较对照早数天。作者认为可能与起搏器组更高的心血管病负担、既往心脏手术更多、糖尿病更多及肾功能受损有关。摘要未报告风险比、95%CI及P值。
AI.conclusion: 无证据表明活动性起搏器延长终末期姑息治疗患者的死亡过程，少数起搏器患者甚至更早死亡；结果对终末期起搏器管理有参考意义，但属回顾性研究、样本量有限且缺乏效应量报告，需谨慎解释。

summary_zh:
背景：照护终末期患者的临床医生经常收到患者及其亲属提出的问题，即是否必须停用起搏器（PM）。处于工作状态的PM对姑息治疗患者死亡过程可能产生的延长生命效应，在文献中仍是一个科学和临床问题，也是终末期照护者和患者面临的挑战。本研究分析了处于工作状态的PM在姑息治疗患者中是否可能存在延长生命的效应。

方法：将83例终末期姑息治疗PM患者从进入姑息治疗病房至死亡所度过的时间，与163例在同一姑息治疗病房（PCU）中匹配的终末期非PM对照患者所度过的时间进行比较。非PM患者按年龄、性别和基础疾病进行匹配。

结果：PM患者与匹配的非PM对照患者的生存曲线在大部分时间完全重合。部分PM患者在入住PCU后10-45天期间死亡，比对照患者早数天。这可能由其更高的心血管疾病患病率、更频繁的既往心脏手术、更多的糖尿病以及肾功能受损来解释。

结论：没有证据表明处于工作状态的PM会延长终末期PCU患者的死亡过程；少数PM患者甚至比其匹配的非PM对照患者死亡更早。

title: Outcomes of leadless pacing with the Micra VR beyond 10 years.
Left ventricular ejection fraction recovery under contemporary quadruple guideline-directed therapy and the need for ICD/CRT-D implantation in HFrEF: a retrospective single-center cohort study
summary: Background Guidelines advise deferring primary-prevention implantable cardioverter-defibrillator (ICD) or cardiac resynchronization therapy-defibrillator (CRT-D) implantation until left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) is reassessed after at least three months of medical therapy in heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF). Real-world data under contemporary quadruple therapy are limited.Research design and methods Retrospective single-center cohort of 65 HFrEF patients (Coburg Hospital, Germany; October 2023-December 2024), prescribed beta-blocker, angiotensin receptor-neprilysin inhibitor, mineralocorticoid receptor antagonist and SGLT2 inhibitor (all four in 92%; doses not recorded). LVEF was measured by echocardiography (TTE) and cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) at baseline and ~3 months; reader blinding was not documented. Device implantation followed guideline criteria. Patients with severe arrhythmic events were excluded.Results Twenty-nine patients (44.6%) received a device. LVEF rose on TTE (28.0→36.0%) and CMR (26.3→38.5%) (both p < 0.001), mainly without device implantation (TTE +13.0 vs + 1.5 points). Larger baseline left ventricular end-diastolic diameter was associated with smaller recovery (β = -0.41, p = 0.006) and device implantation (odds ratio 1.11/mm, 95% CI 1.01-1.22). Adverse events were not recorded.Conclusions LVEF recovery was common, and associations are consistent with disease severity. Findings are hypothesis-generating; absent dose, arrhythmic-outcome and wearable-defibrillator data and the selected cohort limit generalizability.

AI.tldr: 65 例 HFrEF 患者接受四联 GDMT 约 3 个月后 LVEF 明显回升（TTE 28.0→36.0%），但 44.6% 仍按指南植入 ICD/CRT-D，基线左室舒张末径较大者 LVEF 恢复更差。
AI.motivation: 现行指南建议 HFrEF 患者在至少 3 个月规范药物治疗后重新评估 LVEF，再决定是否植入一级预防用 ICD 或 CRT-D，以避免对 LVEF 已回升者进行不必要植入。但上述证据多来自传统药物时代，在血管紧张素受体-脑啡肽酶抑制剂（ARNI）、β 受体阻滞剂、盐皮质激素受体拮抗剂（MRA）与 SGLT2 抑制剂组成的四联指南导向药物治疗（GDMT）背景下，真实世界中 LVEF 恢复的比例及其对器械植入决策的影响仍缺乏数据。
AI.method: 单中心回顾性队列研究（德国 Coburg 医院，2023 年 10 月至 2024 年 12 月），共纳入 65 例 HFrEF 患者，均处方 β 受体阻滞剂、ARNI、MRA 与 SGLT2 抑制剂（92% 患者四药齐全；具体剂量摘要未报告）。于基线和约 3 个月时分别以经胸超声心动图（TTE）和心脏磁共振（CMR）测量 LVEF，摘要未说明读片是否采用盲法。器械植入依据指南标准执行；已发生严重心律失常事件者被排除。主要观察指标为 LVEF 变化及器械植入情况；采用回归分析评估基线左室舒张末内径（LVEDD）与 LVEF 恢复及器械植入的关联，并报告效应量、95%CI 与 P 值。
AI.result: 29 例（44.6%）最终植入器械。TTE 测得 LVEF 由 28.0% 升至 36.0%，CMR 由 26.3% 升至 38.5%（均 p < 0.001）；LVEF 回升主要见于未植入器械者（TTE 增幅 +13.0 个百分点 vs 植入组 +1.5 个百分点）。基线 LVEDD 越大，LVEF 恢复幅度越小（β = -0.41，p = 0.006），且与器械植入风险相关（每增加 1 mm 的比值比 1.11，95%CI 1.01–1.22）。不良事件摘要未报告。
AI.conclusion: 在当代四联 GDMT 背景下，LVEF 恢复较为常见，多数回升者得以避免器械植入；LVEDD 与 LVEF 恢复及器械植入的关联与疾病严重程度相符，提示基线左室扩大者可能是再评估后仍需 ICD/CRT-D 的高危人群。本研究为假设生成性，缺少药物剂量、心律失常结局与可穿戴除颤器数据，且为单中心选择性队列，结果外推需谨慎，尚需前瞻性研究明确再评估时机与器械植入决策。

summary_zh:
背景：指南建议，在射血分数降低的心力衰竭（HFrEF）患者中，应推迟一级预防性植入式心律转复除颤器（ICD）或心脏再同步治疗除颤器（CRT-D）植入，直至接受至少三个月药物治疗后重新评估左心室射血分数（LVEF）。当代四联治疗下的真实世界数据有限。

研究设计与方法：回顾性单中心队列研究，纳入65例HFrEF患者（德国科堡医院；2023年10月至2024年12月），这些患者被处方β受体阻滞剂、血管紧张素受体脑啡肽酶抑制剂、盐皮质激素受体拮抗剂和SGLT2抑制剂（92%的患者四种药物均被处方；未记录剂量）。在基线和约3个月时通过超声心动图（TTE）和心脏磁共振（CMR）测量LVEF；未记录阅片者盲法情况。器械植入遵循指南标准。排除发生严重心律失常事件的患者。

结果：29例患者（44.6%）接受了器械植入。TTE（28.0→36.0%）和CMR（26.3→38.5%）测得的LVEF均升高（两者p < 0.001），且主要见于未植入器械者（TTE +13.0 对 +1.5 个百分点）。基线左心室舒张末期内径较大与LVEF恢复幅度较小相关（β = -0.41，p = 0.006），并与器械植入相关（比值比 1.11/mm，95% CI 1.01-1.22）。未记录不良事件。

结论：LVEF恢复较为常见，相关关联与疾病严重程度一致。本研究结果可产生假设；剂量、心律失常结局和可穿戴式除颤器数据的缺乏，以及所选队列，均限制了普遍适用性。

title: Axillary microaxial flow pump support for stepwise source control and bridge to durable left ventricular assist device therapy in cardiac device-related infective endocarditis.
summary: Cardiac device-related infective endocarditis complicated by end-stage heart failure poses a major therapeutic challenge because complete hardware removal is essential, whereas transvenous lead extraction may be poorly tolerated in patients with severe ventricular dysfunction and shock. We report a 53-year-old man with long-standing dilated cardiomyopathy and cardiac resynchronization therapy-defibrillator infection who presented with methicillin-sensitive Staphylococcus aureus bacteremia, pocket infection, respiratory failure, acute kidney injury, and a clinical presentation consistent with mixed septic-cardiogenic shock. Transthoracic echocardiography showed severe left ventricular dilatation and an ejection fraction of 10%. Because immediate extraction of a 17-year-old defibrillator lead was considered extremely high risk, an Impella 5.5 was implanted via the right subclavian artery, and surgical pocket drainage was performed as initial source control. After hemodynamic stabilization and reduction of vasoactive requirements, complete transvenous extraction of all leads was performed on hospital day 6 under ongoing Impella 5.5 support and cardiovascular surgical backup. During defibrillator lead traction, pulmonary artery pressure transiently decreased, but sustained systemic hemodynamic collapse did not occur. Following prolonged intravenous antibiotic therapy, blood cultures remained negative, renal function recovered sufficiently to discontinue continuous hemodiafiltration, and the patient was transferred to an advanced heart failure center. Durable left ventricular assist device implantation was subsequently performed successfully. This case suggests that axillary Impella 5.5 support may provide a stabilizing platform for staged source control, high-risk lead extraction, end-organ recovery, and bridge to durable mechanical circulatory support in carefully selected patients.

AI.tldr: 53岁长程扩张型心肌病合并CRT-D感染、脓毒性与心源性混合性休克、LVEF 10%的患者，经右腋动脉 Impella 5.5 支持完成分阶段感染源控制与导线拔除，并成功桥接至永久性 LVAD。
AI.motivation: 心脏植入电子装置相关感染性心内膜炎合并终末期心衰时，彻底移除全部装置是治愈前提，但重度左室功能不全与休克患者难以耐受经静脉导线拔除，围术期血流动力学崩溃风险极高。既往缺乏在极低 LVEF 合并混合性休克状态下，以微轴流泵提供过渡支持、分阶段完成感染源控制并桥接至永久性机械循环支持的策略报道。
AI.method: 单例病例报告。对象为53岁男性，长程扩张型心肌病、既往植入 CRT-D（右室除颤导线已留置17年），因甲氧西林敏感金黄色葡萄球菌菌血症、囊袋感染、呼吸衰竭、急性肾损伤入院，临床表现为脓毒性与心源性混合性休克；经胸超声心动图示左室重度扩大、LVEF 10%。因直接拔除除颤导线风险极高，先经右锁骨下动脉植入 Impella 5.5，并行外科囊袋清创引流作为初步感染源控制；待血流动力学稳定、血管活性药物需求下降后，于住院第6天在 Impella 5.5 持续支持及心血管外科后备下经静脉拔除全部导线。摘要未报告统计学方法与终点定义。
AI.result: 除颤导线牵拉过程中心肺动脉压力短暂下降，但未发生持续性全身血流动力学崩溃；术后继续长期静脉抗生素治疗，血培养持续阴性，肾功能恢复至可停用连续血液透析滤过，随后转入晚期心衰中心并成功植入永久性左心室辅助装置。摘要未报告具体血流动力学数值、支持时长及95%置信区间与P值。
AI.conclusion: 本病例提示，对经严格筛选的高危患者，经腋动脉 Impella 5.5 支持可为分阶段感染源控制、高危导线拔除、终末器官功能恢复及桥接至永久性机械循环支持提供稳定的血流动力学平台。作为单例报告，其结论不能外推，需更多病例系列或对照研究验证该策略的可行性与安全性。

title: Utility of an automatic and patient-triggered cardiac event recorder: experience in children.
summary:
OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to evaluate the diagnostic yield of an event recorder capable of automatic and manual recording in children with possible arrhythmia related symptoms.

METHODS: We evaluated retrospectively 81 children monitored with Novacor event recorder system between September 2021 and September 2024. All of the patients performed 12-lead electrocardiogram (ECG), 24-hour-Holter monitoring, and echocardiography before the cardiac event recording.

RESULTS: Indications for cardiac event recorder monitoring were palpitations in 59 (72.8%) patients, chest pain and palpitations in 19 (23.5%) patients, and palpitations and presyncope in 3 (3.7%) patients. After a mean monitoring period of 14.40 ± 7.79 days, 65 (80%) children described symptoms and 41(63%) children had automatically or manually recorded arrhythmias. 63% of these arrhythmias were correlated with the symptoms. Of the 16 (19,8%) patients who were asymptomatic during the enrollment period, 9 (56%) had arrhythmia recorded with automatic arrhythmia detection property only. A total of 107 arrhythmias episodes were registered; forty-six (43%) episodes were patient triggered, and 61 (57%) were automatically recorded. While 24-hour-Holter monitoring detected a clinical diagnosis in 13 patients (16.7%), event recorder diagnosed clinical arrhythmia in 41 children (63%). Based on the event recorder and findings, 10 (12,3%) patients received an electrophysiology study/ablation.

CONCLUSION: We found that the automatic mode of the device provided additional clinical and therapeutic consequences. For this reason, a cardiac event recorder capable of automatically and manually recording may be a more preferable method in children with potentially arrhythmia related symptoms. Studies with larger patient series may provide illuminating data in this area.

AI.tldr: 在81例疑似心律失常相关症状的儿童中，兼具自动与手动记录功能的事件记录仪检出心律失常41例（63%），远高于24小时Holter的13例（16.7%），且57%的发作由自动检测功能捕获。
AI.motivation: 儿童心悸、胸痛、晕厥前兆等症状往往短暂且发作不规律，12导联心电图和24小时Holter监测窗口有限，容易漏诊。既往关于事件记录仪诊断效能的数据多来自成人，儿童中兼具自动检测与患者触发两种模式的事件记录仪的诊断价值尚缺乏证据。
AI.method: 单中心回顾性研究，纳入2021年9月至2024年9月共81例因疑似心律失常相关症状而接受监测的儿童，佩戴Novacor事件记录仪（支持自动检测与手动触发两种记录模式）。所有患儿在事件记录前均完成12导联心电图、24小时Holter监测和超声心动图。评估指标包括记录到心律失常的比例、心律失常与症状的相关性、两种记录模式各自捕获的发作数，并与24小时Holter的诊断率比较。摘要未报告具体统计方法。
AI.result: 监测指征为单纯心悸59例（72.8%）、胸痛伴心悸19例（23.5%）、心悸伴晕厥前兆3例（3.7%）。平均监测14.40±7.79天；65例（80%）描述了症状，41例（63%）记录到自动或手动触发的心律失常，其中63%与症状相关。16例（19.8%）在入组期间无症状，其中9例（56%）仅通过自动检测功能记录到心律失常。共记录107次心律失常发作，46次（43%）为患者触发，61次（57%）为自动记录。24小时Holter在13例（16.7%）中作出临床诊断，事件记录仪在41例（63%）中诊断出临床心律失常。基于事件记录仪结果，10例（12.3%）接受了电生理检查/消融。摘要未报告置信区间与P值。
AI.conclusion: 在儿童中，兼具自动检测与手动触发模式的事件记录仪诊断阳性率明显高于24小时Holter，其自动模式还能在无症状患儿中额外捕获心律失常，并改变了部分患儿的治疗决策（12.3%接受电生理检查/消融），提示对症状可能由心律失常引起的儿童可优先考虑此类设备。局限性为单中心、小样本、回顾性设计，缺乏与金标准的对照及统计学比较，需更大样本研究进一步验证。

目的：本研究旨在评估一种能够自动和手动记录的事件记录仪在具有可能心律失常相关症状的儿童中的诊断检出率。

方法：我们回顾性评估了2021年9月至2024年9月期间使用Novacor事件记录仪系统监测的81名儿童。所有患者在进行心脏事件记录前均接受了12导联心电图（ECG）、24小时动态心电图（Holter）监测和超声心动图检查。

结果：心脏事件记录仪监测的指征为心悸59例（72.8%）、胸痛和心悸19例（23.5%）、心悸和先兆晕厥3例（3.7%）。平均监测14.40 ± 7.79天后，65名（80%）儿童描述了症状，41名（63%）儿童记录到自动或手动记录的心律失常。这些心律失常中有63%与症状相关。在纳入期间无症状的16名（19.8%）患者中，9名（56%）仅通过自动心律失常检测功能记录到心律失常。共记录到107次心律失常发作；其中46次（43%）为患者触发，61次（57%）为自动记录。24小时Holter监测在13名患者（16.7%）中检出临床诊断，而事件记录仪在41名儿童（63%）中诊断出临床心律失常。根据事件记录仪及检查发现，10名（12.3%）患者接受了电生理检查/消融。

结论：我们发现该设备的自动模式提供了额外的临床和治疗影响。因此，对于具有潜在心律失常相关症状的儿童，能够自动和手动记录的心脏事件记录仪可能是更可取的方法。更大患者系列的研究可能为该领域提供有启发性的数据。

title: Differences in Tricuspid Valve Insufficiency, Mechanical Synchrony, and Cardiac Remodeling Between Left Bundle Branch Area Pacing and Right Ventricular Pacing.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Cardiac implantable electronic device-induced tricuspid regurgitation (CIED-induced TR) involves primary (lead-induced) and functional etiologies. The impact of left bundle branch area pacing (LBBAP) versus right ventricular pacing (RVP) on these mechanisms remains unclear.

OBJECTIVE: To compare the incidence and mechanisms of TR among pacing modalities, and evaluate the prognostic significance of these mechanisms.

METHODS: We analyzed 225 patients with first-time RV apical pacing (RVAP, n=97) or RV septal pacing (RVSP, n=78) using stylet-driven leads, and LBBAP (n=50) using lumenless leads. Echocardiography and electrocardiography were performed at baseline and 2 years post-implantation. Three-dimensional echocardiography assessed lead interference. Kaplan-Meier analysis compared event-free survival between lead-induced (LITR) and functional TR (FTR) groups. Cox regression identified predictors for adverse outcomes.

RESULTS: Despite a higher baseline heart failure burden than RVP (P< .001), LBBAP showed the lowest TR progression rate (20.0% vs RVAP 43.3% vs RVSP 35.9%, P=.020) over 25.8 months. Mechanistically, LBBAP shortened QRS duration (vs RVP widening, P< .001) and demonstrated less lead interference than RVAP (28.0% vs 50.5%, P= .009). Furthermore, LBBAP showed greater left-heart reverse remodeling and improvement in mitral regurgitation, while preserving right-heart structure and function better than RVP. Over 37.4 months, LITR showed worse outcomes than FTR (P= .03). LITR, pulmonary hypertension, reduced left ventricular ejection fraction, and elevated creatinine were independent predictors for adverse outcomes.

CONCLUSION: LBBAP was associated with less CIED-induced TR than RVP, likely through reduced mechanical interference, superior electrical synchrony, and favorable cardiac remodeling. Furthermore, LITR was associated with a worse prognosis than FTR.

AI.tldr: 在225例首次植入起搏装置的患者中，左束支区域起搏（LBBAP）的三尖瓣反流（TR）进展率最低（20.0%），低于右室心尖起搏的43.3%和右室间隔起搏的35.9%；其机制可能与导线机械干扰更少、电同步更佳有关。
AI.motivation: 起搏装置相关三尖瓣反流（CIED-induced TR）既包括导线机械性（原发性）因素，也包括功能性因素，两者临床意义可能不同。既往关于右室心尖起搏（RVAP）、右室间隔起搏（RVSP）与新兴的LBBAP在这一问题上的差异缺乏直接比较证据，也缺乏按机制分层（导线相关TR与功能性TR）的预后数据。
AI.method: 对225例首次植入起搏装置的患者进行分组分析：RVAP 97例、RVSP 78例（均使用 stylet-driven 导线），LBBAP 50例（使用 lumenless 导线）。于基线和植入后2年行超声心动图与心电图检查，并用三维超声评价导线对三尖瓣的干扰。主要观察指标为TR进展情况，次要包括QRS时限变化、导线干扰发生率、左、右心重构及二尖瓣反流变化；预后分析采用Kaplan-Meier法比较导线相关TR（LITR）与功能性TR（FTR）组的无事件生存率，并以Cox回归筛选不良结局的独立预测因素。研究设计与前瞻或回顾性质摘要未报告。
AI.result: 中位随访25.8个月，尽管LBBAP组基线心衰负担更重（P<0.001），其TR进展率仍最低（LBBAP 20.0% vs RVAP 43.3% vs RVSP 35.9%，P=0.020）。机制方面，LBBAP缩短QRS时限，而RVP组QRS增宽（P<0.001）；LBBAP的导线干扰率低于RVAP（28.0% vs 50.5%，P=0.009）。LBBAP还带来更明显的左心逆重构和二尖瓣反流改善；与RVP相比，LBBAP对右心结构和功能的保护更好。中位随访37.4个月，LITR组的不良结局多于FTR组（P=0.03）。LITR、肺动脉高压、LVEF降低和肌酐升高是不良结局的独立预测因素（具体HR及95%CI摘要未报告）。
AI.conclusion: 与右室起搏相比，LBBAP与更少的起搏装置相关三尖瓣反流相关，其机制可能在于导线机械干扰更小、电机械同步更优，以及更有利的心脏重构；同时，导线相关TR的预后差于功能性TR，提示对这类患者应加强超声随访。该研究为单中心、非随机、LBBAP样本量较小（50例）的分析，效应量置信区间未报告，结论需更大规模随机研究验证。
